    return n < 2u ? G_PSETTINGS + PS_SIZE * n + PS_VIEW : 0;
}

/* the drift event's styles that the racer's DriftScore lacks (looked for every frame: a new free roam's
 * DriftScore may be where the last one was) */
static void add_styles(CPU *c, uint32_t rc){
    uint32_t ds = guest_rd32(rc + RC_DRIFTSCORE), tab = guest_rd32(G_STYLES), pool = guest_rd32(G_STYLEPOOL);
    if (!guest_ok(ds, 4u * N_STYLES) || !guest_ok(tab, 0x30u * N_STYLES) || !pool) return;
    int added = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < N_STYLES; i++){
        if (!(MR8(tab + 0x30u * i + 7u) & MODE_DRIFT) || MR32(ds + 4u * i)) continue;
        uint32_t s = gcall_main(c, FN_POOL_ALLOC, 0, 1, &pool);
        if (!guest_ok(s, 0x3c)){ fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld no style from the pool (entry %u)\n", autotest_frame(), i); return; }
        MR32(s + 0x34u) = 0; MR32(s + 0x38u) = 0; MR8(s + 0x10u) = 0; MR8(s + 0x18u) = 1;
        MR32(s + 0xcu) = i; MR32(s + 8u) = tab + 0x30u * i;
        gcall_main(c, FN_STYLE_INIT, s, 0, 0);
        MR32(ds + 4u * i) = s;
        MR8(s + 0x10u) = 1;
        added++;
    }
    if (!added) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld the drift event's styles: %d added to free roam's DriftScore 0x%08x\n", autotest_frame(), added, ds);
}
/* free roam has no route: the DriftCar's best route distance follows the car's down */
static void no_route(uint32_t rc){
    uint32_t dc = guest_rd32(rc + RC_DRIFTCAR), car = dc && guest_ok(dc, DC_BEST + 4u) ? guest_rd32(dc + DC_CAR) : 0, rt = car ? guest_rd32(car + 0x1cu) : 0;
    if (!guest_ok(rt, 0x18)) return;
    float d = MRF32(rt + 0x14u);
    if (MRF32(dc + DC_BEST) > d) MRF32(dc + DC_BEST) = d;
}
/* the points of drifts banked since the last frame */
static void count(uint32_t rc){
    uint32_t ds = guest_rd32(rc + RC_DRIFTSCORE), st = guest_ok(ds, 3) ? guest_rd32(ds) : 0;
    if (!guest_ok(st, ST_TOTAL + 4u)) return;
    float tot = MRF32(st + ST_TOTAL);
    if (st != D.style){ D.style = st; D.last = tot; return; }
    if (tot >= D.last + 1.f){
        double got = (double)(int)(tot - D.last);
        D.total += got;
        if (got > D.best) D.best = got;
        fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld a drift of %.0f (total %.0f, best %.0f)\n", autotest_frame(), got, D.total, D.best);
    }
    D.last = tot;
}

/* free roam's style popup, which stays up while the switch is on (see the top) */
static void hide_popup(CPU *c){
    uint32_t pl = guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1), hud = pl ? guest_rd32(pl + PL_HUD) : 0, el = hud ? guest_rd32(hud + HUD_STYLES) : 0;
    if (!guest_ok(el, 0x3c)) return;
    for (uint32_t o = 0x34u; o <= 0x38u; o += 4u){
        uint32_t obj = guest_rd32(el + o);
        if (guest_ok(obj, 0x20) && !(MR32(obj + 0x1cu) & 1u)) gcall_main(c, FN_FE_HIDE, 0, 1, &obj);
    }
}

static void camera_on(CPU *c){
    uint32_t va = view_addr(), pl = guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1);
    if (!va || !pl) return;
    uint32_t v = MR32(va);
    if (v != VIEW_DRIFT){
        D.saved = v;
        MR32(va) = VIEW_DRIFT - 1u;
        uint32_t one = 1;
        gcall_main(c, FN_CAMERA_KEY, pl, 1, &one);
    } else D.saved = VIEW_DRIFT;                   /* the player's own pick (cameras.c: every drive has the view) */
    D.cam = MR32(va) == VIEW_DRIFT;
    if (!D.cam){ MR32(va) = v; fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld no drift camera (view %u)\n", autotest_frame(), v); }
}
/* live: the world's camera too (the camera key's way), else only the view the next one is made for */
static void camera_off(CPU *c, int live){
    uint32_t va = view_addr(), pl = guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1), back = D.saved <= VIEW_LAST ? D.saved : 3u;
    D.cam = 0;
    if (!va || MR32(va) != VIEW_DRIFT || MR8(G_DRIFTRACE) || back == VIEW_DRIFT) return;
    if (live && pl){
        MR32(va) = back - 1u;                      /* the camera key's step wraps a -1 to 0 */
        uint32_t one = 1;
        gcall_main(c, FN_CAMERA_KEY, pl, 1, &one);
    } else MR32(va) = back;
}

uint32_t garage_find(uint32_t db, uint32_t h);   /* garage.c: a front-end car record by handle (slots 6-10 too) */

/* The car made again (0x5F6C20) with its nitrous as it was: the shot's length (a drift event's is 0) and what is left
 * of it (see the top) */
static void car_tuned(CPU *c, uint32_t car){
    uint32_t ph = guest_rd32(car + CAR_PHYS), nos[4], one = 1;
    int keep = guest_ok(ph, PH_NOS_LEN + 3u) && guest_ok(car + CAR_NOS_STATE, 15u);
    float len = keep ? MRF32(ph + PH_NOS_LEN) : 0.f;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; keep && i < 4u; i++) nos[i] = MR32(car + CAR_NOS_STATE + 4u * i);
    gcall_main(c, FN_CAR_TUNED, car, 1, &one);
    if (!keep || guest_rd32(car + CAR_PHYS) != ph) return;
    MRF32(ph + PH_NOS_LEN) = len;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4u; i++) MR32(car + CAR_NOS_STATE + 4u * i) = nos[i];
}

/* The car's physics made again with the switch on: a drift event's handling (parameter set 3) and the car's Drift
 * setup from the dyno in its ride (see the top) */
static void physics_in(CPU *c){
    uint32_t car = guest_rd32(guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1) + 4u), ride = car ? guest_rd32(car + CAR_RIDE) : 0,
             rec = MR32(G_GAMEMODE) == 1u ? garage_find(G_FECARS, guest_rd32(G_CAREER_CAR)) : 0;
    if (!guest_ok(ride, RIDE_TUNING + SETUP_SZ)) return;
    uint32_t setup = guest_ok(rec, REC_SETUPS + 5u * SETUP_SZ) ? rec + REC_SETUPS + SETUP_DRIFT * SETUP_SZ : 0;
    int differ = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; setup && i < SETUP_SZ; i++) differ += MR8(setup + i) != MR8(ride + RIDE_TUNING + i);
    if (differ){
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < SETUP_SZ; i++){ D.kept[i] = MR8(ride + RIDE_TUNING + i); MR8(ride + RIDE_TUNING + i) = MR8(setup + i); }
        D.swapped = 1;
    }
    D.tuned = car;
    car_tuned(c, car);
    fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld the car's physics for a drift event%s (%d of %u values from the dyno's Drift setup), its nitrous kept\n",
            autotest_frame(), !setup ? ", no Drift setup of its own" : "", differ, SETUP_SZ);
}
/* ... and as they were, while the car is still the one (out of the world: the next car is made new) */
static void physics_out(CPU *c){
    uint32_t car = D.tuned, ride = car ? guest_rd32(car + CAR_RIDE) : 0;
    int same = car && guest_rd32(guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1) + 4u) == car && guest_ok(ride, RIDE_TUNING + SETUP_SZ);
    /* The drift assist (0x5AC260, every physics step while the switch is on) sets the rear wheels' grip factor, and
     * nothing puts it back: only a new car's wheels (a respawn, a reset) have 1 again.  Left as it was, the car slid
     * more after drift mode than in it (0.86 standing still; 25 degrees of slip in a test turn against 11) */
    if (same){
        uint32_t po = guest_rd32(car + CAR_PHYSOBJ);
        for (uint32_t o = 0x40u; guest_ok(po, 0x48) && o <= 0x44u; o += 4u){
            uint32_t w = guest_rd32(po + o);
            if (guest_ok(w, WH_GRIP + 3u)) MRF32(w + WH_GRIP) = 1.f;
        }
    }
    if (same && D.swapped) for (uint32_t i = 0; i < SETUP_SZ; i++) MR8(ride + RIDE_TUNING + i) = D.kept[i];
    D.tuned = 0; D.swapped = 0;
    if (!car) return;
    if (!same || guest_rd32(G_FLOW) != 6u){ fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld the car is gone: no physics to give back\n", autotest_frame()); return; }
    car_tuned(c, car);
    fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld the car's own physics back\n", autotest_frame());
}
/* the dyno setup friends' games show the car with (roam_game.c): the ride's own while the Drift setup is in, so X is
 * no new look (a car loaded again in every friend's game) */
int drift_kept_tuning(uint8_t *out){
    if (!D.swapped) return 0;
    memcpy(out, D.kept, SETUP_SZ);
    return 1;
}

/* the status, every frame it changes (a drift's points: every frame of it), all in one consistent section */
static void publish(void){
    static const char *const k[8] = { "drift", "drift_key", "drift_x", "drift_gain", "drift_total", "drift_best", "drift_st", "drift_pend" };
    if (!D.slots){ D.slots = 1; for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++){ D.slot[i] = host_status_slot(k[i]); D.val[i] = -1; } }
    uint32_t dc = 0, st = 0, rc = D.on ? racer() : 0, ds = rc ? guest_rd32(rc + RC_DRIFTSCORE) : 0;
    if (rc) dc = guest_rd32(rc + RC_DRIFTCAR);
    if (guest_ok(ds, 3)) st = guest_rd32(ds);
    if (!guest_ok(st, ST_TOTAL + 4u)) st = 0;
    int lvl = dc && guest_ok(dc, DC_GAIN + 4u) ? (int)MR32(dc + DC_LEVEL) : 1;
    if (lvl < 1 || lvl > 5) lvl = 1;
    float pend = st ? MRF32(st + ST_PEND) : 0.f;
    double v[8] = { (double)(D.want | (D.on ? 2 : 0) | (D.note ? 4 : 0)), (double)D.keys, (double)lvl,
                    lvl < 5 && dc ? (double)(int32_t)MR32(dc + DC_GAIN) : 0.0, D.total, D.best,
                    st ? (double)MR32(st + ST_STATE) : 2.0, pend > 0.f && pend < 1e9f ? (double)(int)pend : 0.0 };
    int changed = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) changed |= v[i] != D.val[i];
    if (!changed) return;
    memcpy(D.val, v, sizeof v);
    host_status_set_n(D.slot, v, 8);
}

/* X is a letter here: the front end (and the loading screens), or the game's text entry is up */
static int x_is_typing(void){
    return guest_rd32(G_FLOW) != 6u || (mem_is_committed(G_TXT_REC + 3u) && MR8(G_TXT_ON) && MR32(G_TXT_REC));
}

/* ---- drift battles ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* A drift battle between two players (roam_game.c du_*) is drift mode with a clock.  From its start (drift_battle_begin,
 * the countdown) drift mode is on, whatever the player had (X does nothing but say so: drift_battle_x), and the car has
 * no nitrous, as in a drift event: 0x591CD0 makes a car's nitrous from its physics' shot length (+0x2A0), and with a
 * length of 0, as a drift event's, the full shot (+0x414), its share (+0x418), what is left (+0x41C) and when it went
 * on (+0x420) are all 0; kept so every frame, whatever a drift or a remade car would give back.  At the off
 * (drift_battle_go) the points start: the multiplier back to X1 and a drift under way dropped, as the game's own
 * respawn in a drift event does (0x6009A0 calls DriftCar 0x56DFA0: X1, and a drift that counts or starts ends lost,
 * 0x56D5C0); the battle's points are those banked since then (drift_battle_score), and at the end the drift that
 * counts then as it stands.  At its end (drift_battle_end) drift mode is as the player had chosen and the nitrous as
 * it was when the battle started (no shot more, none less). */
#define FN_DC_RESET    0x0056dfa0u   /* thiscall DriftCar: X1, a drift under way dropped */
static struct {
    int on, want;                     /* a battle runs; drift mode as the player had chosen before it */
    int go; double base;              /* its points count, from D.total then */
    uint32_t car, ph; float len;      /* the car whose nitrous is off, its physics, their shot's length before ... */
    uint32_t nos[4];                  /* ... and its nitrous (CAR_NOS_STATE) */
    uint32_t xs;                      /* X presses meanwhile */
} B;
int drift_wanted(void){ return D.want; }
/* the view drift mode's drift camera is in (cameras.c: not the player's own), 0 none */
uint32_t drift_camera_view(void){ return D.cam ? view_addr() : 0; }
/* the controller's switch (showoff.c: D-pad down held a second while driving), as X */
void drift_pad(void){ D.pad++; }
static void nos_off(void){
    uint32_t pl = guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1), car = pl ? guest_rd32(pl + 4u) : 0, ph = car ? guest_rd32(car + CAR_PHYS) : 0;
    if (!guest_ok(ph, PH_NOS_LEN + 3u) || !guest_ok(car + CAR_NOS_STATE, 15u)) return;
    if (car != B.car){
        if (B.car) fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld drift battle: another car (0x%08x), its nitrous off too\n", autotest_frame(), car);
        B.car = car; B.ph = ph; B.len = MRF32(ph + PH_NOS_LEN);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4u; i++) B.nos[i] = MR32(car + CAR_NOS_STATE + 4u * i);
        fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld drift battle: no nitrous (a %.1f s shot, %u/4000 s of it left kept)\n", autotest_frame(),
                (double)B.len, B.nos[2]);
    }
    B.ph = ph;
    if (MRF32(ph + PH_NOS_LEN) != 0.f) MRF32(ph + PH_NOS_LEN) = 0.f;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4u; i++) if (MR32(car + CAR_NOS_STATE + 4u * i)) MR32(car + CAR_NOS_STATE + 4u * i) = 0;
}
static void nos_back(void){
    uint32_t pl = guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1), car = pl ? guest_rd32(pl + 4u) : 0, ph = car ? guest_rd32(car + CAR_PHYS) : 0;
    if (!B.car) return;
    if (car == B.car && guest_rd32(G_FLOW) == 6u && guest_ok(ph, PH_NOS_LEN + 3u) && guest_ok(car + CAR_NOS_STATE, 15u)){
        MRF32(ph + PH_NOS_LEN) = B.len;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4u; i++) MR32(car + CAR_NOS_STATE + 4u * i) = B.nos[i];
        fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld drift battle over: the nitrous back as it was\n", autotest_frame());
    } else fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld drift battle over: the car is gone, no nitrous to give back\n", autotest_frame());
    B.car = 0;
}
/* the countdown: drift mode on, the nitrous off */
void drift_battle_begin(void){
    if (B.on) return;
    memset(&B, 0, sizeof B);
    B.on = 1; B.want = D.want; D.want = 1;
    fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld drift battle: drift mode on for it (it was %s)\n", autotest_frame(), B.want ? "on" : "off");
}
/* the off: the points from now, from X1 */
void drift_battle_go(CPU *c){
    if (!B.on || B.go) return;
    uint32_t rc = racer(), dc = rc ? guest_rd32(rc + RC_DRIFTCAR) : 0, ds = dc && guest_ok(dc, DC_BEST + 4u) ? guest_rd32(dc) : 0;
    int lvl = dc && guest_ok(dc, DC_GAIN + 4u) ? (int)MR32(dc + DC_LEVEL) : 0;
    if (guest_ok(ds, 3) && guest_ok(guest_rd32(ds), ST_TOTAL + 4u)) gcall_main(c, FN_DC_RESET, dc, 0, 0);
    B.go = 1; B.base = D.total;
    fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld drift battle: the points count from now (the multiplier was X%d%s)\n", autotest_frame(), lvl,
            ds ? "" : ", no drift yet");
}
/* the battle's points: banked since the off, and the drift that counts now (0 before the off) */
void drift_battle_score(double *banked, double *pend){
    *banked = *pend = 0;
    if (!B.on || !B.go) return;
    *banked = D.total - B.base;
    uint32_t rc = racer(), ds = rc ? guest_rd32(rc + RC_DRIFTSCORE) : 0, st = guest_ok(ds, 3) ? guest_rd32(ds) : 0;
    if (!guest_ok(st, ST_TOTAL + 4u)) return;
    uint32_t s = MR32(st + ST_STATE);
    float p = MRF32(st + ST_PEND);
    if ((s == 0u || s == 1u) && p > 0.f && p < 1e9f) *pend = (double)(int)p;
}
/* X presses in the battle so far (none switch drift mode) */
uint32_t drift_battle_x(void){ return B.xs; }
/* over: drift mode as chosen before, the nitrous back */
void drift_battle_end(void){
    if (!B.on) return;
    nos_back();
    D.want = B.want; B.on = 0; B.go = 0;
    fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld drift battle over: drift mode %s, as before it\n", autotest_frame(), D.want ? "on" : "off");
}

void drift_frame(CPU *c){
    int world = roam_world(), top = world && hud_on_top(), drive = top && MR32(race()) == 4u;
    int typing = x_is_typing(), nx = x_presses(), np = D.pad;
    if (typing) nx = 0;
    D.pad = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nx + np; i++){
        const char *how = i < nx ? "X" : "D-pad down held";
        if (B.on && world){ B.xs++; fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld %s in a drift battle: drift mode stays on\n", autotest_frame(), how); continue; }
        D.keys++;
        D.note = !world;
        if (world){ D.want = !D.want; fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld drift mode %s (%s)\n", autotest_frame(), D.want ? "on" : "off", how); }
        else fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld %s outside free roam: nothing\n", autotest_frame(), how);
    }
    int on = D.want && drive;
    if (on != D.on){
        D.on = on;
        MR32(G_FORCEDRIFT) = (uint32_t)on;
        fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld drift handling %s%s\n", autotest_frame(), on ? "on" : "off",
                on ? "" : !D.want ? "" : !world ? " (not in free roam)" : !top ? " (a screen over the HUD)" : " (paused)");
        if (on) physics_in(c);
        else physics_out(c);
    }
    if (on){
        uint32_t rc = racer();
        if (rc){ add_styles(c, rc); no_route(rc); count(rc); }
        hide_popup(c);
        if (!D.cam) camera_on(c);
    } else if (D.cam && (!D.want || !world)) camera_off(c, guest_rd32(G_FLOW) == 6u && hud_on_top());
    if (B.on && guest_rd32(G_FLOW) == 6u) nos_off();
    publish();
}

/* Music in drag and drift events (NFSU2_RACE_MUSIC, the page's race_music; off by default): the page writes 1 or 0,
 * the Mac app passes the line's own on/off */
static int race_music(void){
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0){
        on = setting_bool("NFSU2_RACE_MUSIC", 0);
        if (on) fprintf(stderr, "[drift] music in drag and drift races: on (NFSU2_RACE_MUSIC)\n");
    }
    return on;
}
/* The music's tests of a drift or drag event: none while the switch is ours (free roam's songs, at their volume), and
 * none of the race's own with race_music on (a drag or drift event's songs as a circuit race has them). */
int drift_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    static int told;                             /* the event last told: 0 none, 1 drag, 2 drift */
    switch (ip){
    case HOOK_SITE(0x00482279):                  /* the music manager: test al, al (0x401910, a drift event?) */
        if ((D.on && !MR8(G_DRIFTRACE)) || race_music()) c->eax &= ~0xffu;
        return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x00482287):                  /* test al, al (0x4018F0, a drag event?) */
        if (race_music()){
            int kind = MR8(G_DRAGRACE) ? 1 : MR8(G_DRIFTRACE) ? 2 : 0;
            if (kind != told && kind)
                fprintf(stderr, "[drift] f=%ld a %s race: its songs play (race_music)\n", autotest_frame(), kind == 1 ? "drag" : "drift");
            told = kind;
            c->eax &= ~0xffu;
        }
        return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x00471b7a):                  /* the in-game mix: test al, al (al = [0x89E7D8], a drag event) */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x00471b8c):                  /* test al, al (al = [0x89E7D9], a drift event) */
        if (race_music()) c->eax &= ~0xffu;
        return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x00471b95):                  /* test eax, eax (eax = [0x890104]) */
        if (D.on && !MR8(G_DRIFTRACE)) c->eax = 0;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* drifttest.c -- test helpers for the drift fidelity work.  Nothing here is
 * active unless asked for.
 *
 *   NFSU2_FIXED_DT = <hz>
 *       The world time step the game simulates (the value 0x601A60 returns
 *       into [0x865154], which World::DoTimestep, the car physics, the drift
 *       scoring and the WorldTimer use) becomes exactly 1/hz whenever the
 *       game asks for a step > 0.  The simulation is then independent of how
 *       long a frame really took: a slow test binary (the oracle) or a loaded
 *       machine replays the same physics, and 60 vs 120 Hz stepping can be
 *       compared with identical input timing in game time.  The render rate
 *       and real-dt consumers (camera, audio, HUD timers) are not touched.
 *       A comma list (e.g. 60,20) cycles through the rates frame by frame: a
 *       reproducible uneven frame time, like a slow device's.
 */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

void sub_00601a60_orig(CPU *);
/* GRaceStatus world-time scaler (thiscall, 1 float arg, float in ST0):
 * time scale [0x7A5730] and the online clock correction. */
void sub_00601a60(CPU *c){
    static float step[16]; static int nstep = -1, k = 0;
    if (nstep < 0){
        nstep = 0;
        const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_FIXED_DT");
        for (const char *p = e ? e : ""; *p && nstep < 16; ){
            const char *q = p;
            double hz = strtod(q, (char **)&p);
            if (p == q) break;                          /* not a number */
            if (hz > 0.0) step[nstep++] = (float)(1.0 / hz);
            while (*p == ',' || *p == ' ') p++;
        }
        if (nstep) fprintf(stderr, "[drifttest] fixed world step: %d rate(s) from %s\n", nstep, e);
    }
    sub_00601a60_orig(c);
    if (nstep && ST(0) > 0.0){ ST(0) = (double)step[k]; k = (k + 1) % nstep; }
    /* photo mode's shutter (photo.c): each of its picture's frames a step of the world of its own length */
    int photo_world_step(double *st0);
    double st = ST(0);
    if (photo_world_step(&st)) ST(0) = st;
}

/* D3DX HLE stage 2: a record of the IDirect3DDevice9 calls a guest
 * function makes, and the "would it be a no-op if done now" check.
 * The record is kept in com.c (the device state copies live there); the
 * user is runtime/d3dx_hle.c.                                           */
#ifndef DXREC_H
#define DXREC_H
#include <stdint.h>


typedef struct {
    int16_t  mid;            /* com.c method id */
    uint16_t doff, dlen;     /* constant data inside data[] */
    uint8_t  red;            /* was a no-op when recorded */
    uint32_t a[3];           /* first 3 arguments after this */
} DxCall;

/* Capacity per record: a state record holds 8 calls / 256 bytes, a pass
 * record more.  The call/data arrays live in the struct that carries the
 * record; DXREC_INIT wires them up. */
typedef struct {
    uint8_t  kind;           /* DXREC_PASS / DXREC_STATE */
    uint8_t  ok;             /* 0: cannot be memoized (unsupported call, nested, overflow, state block) */
    uint8_t  allred;         /* every call was a no-op while recording */
    uint16_t ncall, maxcall;
    uint16_t ndata, maxdata;
    DxCall  *call;
    uint8_t *data;
} DxRec;
#define DXREC_INIT(r, calls, databuf) do{ (r)->call = (calls); (r)->data = (databuf); \
    (r)->maxcall = (uint16_t)(sizeof(calls)/sizeof((calls)[0])); \
    (r)->maxdata = (uint16_t)sizeof(databuf); (r)->ok = 0; (r)->ncall = (r)->ndata = 0; }while(0)

#define DXREC_PASS  1
#define DXREC_STATE 2
/* A state record inside a pass is normal.  If a new record starts inside a
 * STATE record (nested apply = compound), ALL outer records become
 * invalid; a nested record of the same kind also invalidates the outer one. */
void dxrec_begin(DxRec *r, int kind);
void dxrec_append(const DxRec *src); /* add a skipped state's recorded calls to the open records */
void dxrec_end(void);
int  dxrec_redundant(const DxRec *r);/* is every recorded call a no-op NOW */
int  dxrec_sb_recording(void);
const char *dxrec_mid_name(int mid);       /* is a state block recording open (no skipping) */

#endif

/* dyno.c -- Performance Tuning / Dyno keeps the setups it saves: Save Profile
 * and Quit Tuning put them into the car first.
 *
 * The game (SPEED2.EXE v1.2 NA).  The dyno object 0x839C40 (0x5309E0 starts a
 * visit, 0x50F970 / 0x53CC70 end it):
 *  +0      the car's record in the front end's cars (the lookups by handle,
 *          garage.c's slots 6-10 too), whose 5 setups of 0x29 bytes at +0x360
 *          (0 circuit and sprint, 1 drag, 2 drift, 3 and 4 the others; each
 *          byte 100 untouched) are what the profile saves: a career car's
 *          record goes into it from +0x18 to +0x42F (0x516620);
 *  +0x900  the setup being tuned: the car's ride +0x384, its setup at +0x14;
 *  +0x904  the visit's copy of the 5 (0x50F800 makes it from the record);
 *  +0x9FC  the kind being tuned (0xFF none).
 * Mode Select (the dyno menu's 4th item, vtable 0x79B768, built at 0x522938;
 * its action 0x55A580), with the setup being tuned other than the visit's
 * copy of its kind, asks "Your current custom-tuned setup has changed. Would
 * you like to store it?": Yes (0x2B5DFEF6) copies it there (0x50FC20, the
 * kind), No (0xB4EDEB6D) does not; both go on to UI_PerformanceTuning_Setting
 * (0x5648FA), which loads the kind chosen from the visit's copy (0x50FC60).
 * 0x50FAE0 (the kind) puts the visit's 5 into the record, the one being tuned
 * over its kind's; 0x50FD10 says whether one differs from the record's.
 * The dyno's menu (UI_PerformanceDyno_MAIN, vtable 0x79D30C, messages
 * 0x5647E0):
 *  - Quit Tuning's "Quit to Garage?" Yes (0x30ED2368): with a setup changed
 *    and the game's Save option on ([0x844AD8]) it asks "One of your
 *    custom-tuned setups has changed. Would you like to save your profile
 *    now?": Yes (0x24DD40CF) puts them into the record and saves, No
 *    (0x1FAB5998) puts them in and leaves.  With the Save option Off it
 *    leaves at once: its jump (0x564963) lands on the leaving (0x564897), past
 *    the putting in (0x564886) just before it, and the setups are lost;
 *  - Save Profile (on the menu while a setup has changed) asks "Are you sure
 *    you want to save your profile?": Yes (0x51123592) saves the profile
 *    (0x4A3100, job 0x51) with the record as it was, without the setups.
 * So the next visit had the setups of before (a player's report: "the Dyno
 * settings aren't being saved ... revert to their original defaults").  Here
 * both put the setups into the record first, as Quit's own answers do: the
 * record's own fields, so the profile stays the PC game's.  Save Profile
 * stores the one being tuned into the visit's copy first, as Mode Select's Yes
 * does: else the visit's copy, older than the record, comes back over it (Mode
 * Select answered No reloads the kind from it, and the next putting in, Quit's,
 * writes it).  With that nothing differs from the record any more: a save
 * cancelled after this Yes leaves the setups in the car unsaved, as Quit's No
 * does (the profile has them at its next save), and Quit Tuning does not ask
 * again.  Original: none of this. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include <stdio.h>

void dispatch_patch(uint32_t a, void (*f)(CPU *));
long autotest_frame(void);
void sub_005647e0(CPU *c);

#define DYNO            0x00839c40u   /* the dyno object */
#define D_RECORD        0x000u        /* the car's record */
#define D_TUNED         0x900u        /* the setup being tuned (its +0x14) */
#define D_KIND          0x9fcu        /* the kind being tuned, 0xFF none */
#define REC_SETUPS      0x360u        /* a record: its 5 setups */
#define SETUP_SZ        0x29u
#define G_SAVE_OPTION   0x00844ad8u   /* byte: the game's Save option, 0 Off ([0x844AD9] 1 Autosave, 0 Prompt) */
#define FN_DYNO_MSG     0x005647e0u   /* thiscall the dyno's menu (msg, obj, a3, a4), ret 0x10 */
#define FN_PUT_IN       0x0050fae0u   /* thiscall dyno (kind), ret 4: the setups into the record */
#define FN_STORE        0x0050fc20u   /* thiscall dyno (kind), ret 4: the one being tuned into the visit's copy */
#define FN_CHANGED      0x0050fd10u   /* thiscall dyno -> al: a setup differs from the record's */
#define MSG_QUIT_YES    0x30ed2368u   /* "Quit to Garage?" Yes */
#define MSG_SAVE_YES    0x51123592u   /* Save Profile's "Are you sure ...?" Yes */

static void dyno_msg(CPU *c){
    uint32_t m = MR32(c->esp + 4u), rec = guest_rd32(DYNO + D_RECORD), kind = guest_rd32(DYNO + D_KIND);
    if ((m == MSG_SAVE_YES || (m == MSG_QUIT_YES && !MR8(G_SAVE_OPTION))) && rec && guest_ok(rec + REC_SETUPS, 5u * SETUP_SZ)
        && guest_rd32(DYNO + D_TUNED) && kind < 5u && (gcall(c, FN_CHANGED, DYNO, 0, 0) & 0xffu)){
        if (m == MSG_SAVE_YES) gcall(c, FN_STORE, DYNO, 1, &kind);
        gcall(c, FN_PUT_IN, DYNO, 1, &kind);
        fprintf(stderr, "[dyno] f=%ld %s: the setups into the car (record 0x%08x, kind %u)\n", autotest_frame(),
                m == MSG_SAVE_YES ? "Save Profile" : "Quit Tuning with the Save option Off", rec, kind);
    }
    sub_005647e0(c);
}

void dyno_install(void){ dispatch_patch(FN_DYNO_MSG, dyno_msg); }

/* engage.c -- Engage at a marker in the career's free roam (a shop or garage door, a race start, a cover shoot):
 * mended when the game would refuse it for good, and logged when it refuses.
 *
 * Players reported the prompt up at a marker (the top left's icon) but Enter doing nothing, at shops, race starts and
 * a timed cover shoot's target, the last one a career stuck before stage 5 (2026-11).  The prompt and Engage are two
 * tests of the game's: the prompt (0x5EAFB0 -> 0x532A50) asks only whether the car is in the marker's trigger, Engage
 * (Player::HandleAction 0x602BD0, case 16, at 0x602D99) also wants the career not engaging already (Career +0x7138,
 * a byte: set there, cleared only by the engage manager's handler 0x606730 and a career's load 0x532830) and the
 * showcase preview's byte 0x85EF6C clear (its sub-modes set it, its Back 0x5295B0 clears it).  Left set, every
 * marker after says yes and does nothing until the next load.
 *
 * Each frame of the career's free roam with the HUD on top and the engage manager free ([[0x8900D8]] 4): either byte
 * set that long (STUCK frames) is cleared, as the game leaves them with nothing engaged, and logged.  And an Engage
 * pressed at a marker that brings no screen up within a second logs what Engage tests, for the next report. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "game.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

const char *autotest_top_fng(void);
long autotest_frame(void);

#define C_ENGAGING      0x7138u       /* byte: an Engage under way */
#define G_PREVIEW       0x0085ef6cu   /* byte: the showcase preview's sub-mode on */
#define G_ENGAGE_MGR    0x008900d8u   /* -> the engage manager: +0 its state (4 free) */
#define ENGAGE_FREE     4u
#define G_ACTIONS       0x0086eaf0u   /* the actions held this frame, a bit each, 0 = held */
#define ACT_ENGAGE      15u
#define PL_MARKER       0x9acu        /* Player: the marker Engage would enter */
#define STUCK           120           /* frames */
#define NO_SCREEN       60            /* frames after an Engage at a marker */

static int ok4(uint32_t a){ return a && mem_is_committed(a) && mem_is_committed(a + 3u); }

void engage_frame(CPU *c){
    (void)c;
    static long stuck_eng, stuck_prev, pressed_at = -1;
    static int was_held;
    static uint32_t snap[6];
    long f = autotest_frame();
    const char *top = autotest_top_fng();
    uint32_t mgr = MR32(G_ENGAGE_MGR), pl = MR32(SPLIT_PLAYERS_INDEX);
    int roam = MR32(G_GAMEMODE) == 1u && MR32(G_RACETYPE) == 0u && top && !strcasecmp(top, "HUD_SingleRace.fng");
    int idle = roam && ok4(mgr) && MR32(mgr) == ENGAGE_FREE;
    /* a byte left set with nothing engaged */
    if (idle && MR8(G_CAREER + C_ENGAGING)){
        if (!stuck_eng) stuck_eng = f;
        else if (f - stuck_eng >= STUCK){
            MR8(G_CAREER + C_ENGAGING) = 0; stuck_eng = 0;
            fprintf(stderr, "[engage] f=%ld the career was left engaging with nothing engaged (Career +0x7138): cleared, Enter at a marker works again\n", f);
        }
    } else stuck_eng = 0;
    if (idle && MR8(G_PREVIEW)){
        if (!stuck_prev) stuck_prev = f;
        else if (f - stuck_prev >= STUCK){
            MR8(G_PREVIEW) = 0; stuck_prev = 0;
            fprintf(stderr, "[engage] f=%ld the showcase preview's mode was left on in free roam (0x85EF6C): cleared, Enter at a marker works again\n", f);
        }
    } else stuck_prev = 0;
    /* an Engage at a marker that brought nothing up */
    int held = !(MR32(G_ACTIONS) & (1u << ACT_ENGAGE));
    uint32_t marker = ok4(pl + PL_MARKER) ? MR32(pl + PL_MARKER) : 0u;
    if (held && !was_held && roam && marker && pressed_at < 0){
        pressed_at = f;
        snap[0] = marker; snap[1] = MR8(G_CAREER + C_ENGAGING); snap[2] = MR8(G_PREVIEW);
        snap[3] = ok4(mgr) ? MR32(mgr) : 0xffffffffu; snap[4] = ok4(mgr + 0x4cu) ? MR32(mgr + 0x4cu) : 0xffffffffu;
        snap[5] = MR32(G_GAMEMODE);
    }
    was_held = held;
    if (pressed_at >= 0 && f - pressed_at >= NO_SCREEN){
        if (roam)                                     /* still the HUD: nothing came up */
            fprintf(stderr, "[engage] f=%ld Enter at marker %08x brought nothing up: engaging %u, preview %u, engage manager %u (kind %u), mode %u\n",
                    f, snap[0], snap[1], snap[2], snap[3], snap[4], snap[5]);
        pressed_at = -1;
    }
}

/* Graphics enhancements.  See enhance.h.
 *
 * 0) RUNTIME OPTIONS (every build)
 *    The HD build's features that passed the image and frame-time
 *    measurements are options of the normal binary, all
 *    off by default (the frame is then the original's, bit for bit):
 *      NFSU2_GRAPHICS = original | enhanced | custom   preset (settings.ini graphics)
 *          original  the original look; the options below are ignored
 *          enhanced  msaa auto, mirror high, texture_filtering anisotropic;
 *                    an option below that is set overrides its item
 *          custom    only the options below (each off unless set)
 *          unset     custom when one of the options below is set, else original
 *      NFSU2_MSAA = off | 2 | 4 | auto        MSAA of the screen passes (3)
 *      NFSU2_MIRROR = original | high | <px>  rear-view mirror target 256 -> 1024 (1)
 *      NFSU2_TEXTURE_FILTERING = game | anisotropic
 *                                             16x AF where the game asks for it
 *                                             (= the game's g_TextureFiltering 2)
 *    The research build (NFS_ENHANCED, ./link.sh hd, not packaged) keeps
 *    upstream's defaults and HD_* variables, plus the larger road reflection
 *    with its blur fix (2; also NFSU2_ROAD_REFLECTION = original | high | <f>
 *    there), SSR, ray tracing and the larger cube map: rejected for the
 *    shipped app (no real improvement on the original look, or artifacts).
 *
 * 1) REFLECTION RESOLUTION
 *    The game draws three reflections into separate render targets:
 *      road reflection   320x240   (scaled up 6x horizontally at 1080p)
 *      rear-view mirror  256x256
 *      car cube map      128/face
 *    The targets are recognized by their CALL ADDRESS (our exe, v1.2 NA, SHA-256 f9dd86c0...).
 *    The community mods' addresses are shifted in this exe; the ones here
 *    come from our own disassembly:
 *      0x5BA097  CreateTexture(320,240,RT)   road reflection
 *      0x5BA10D  CreateTexture(320,240,RT)   road reflection blur
 *                                            (reflection level 3 only)
 *      0x5BA1CD  CreateTexture([7FEE80],[7FEE84],RT)  rear-view mirror
 *      0x5BA549  CreateCubeTexture([7FEE6C],RT)       car environment map
 *    The Z surfaces (0x5BA0D9, 0x5BA20C, 0x5BA59A) are left alone: Metal
 *    creates the Z texture at the size of the first target it is used with.
 *
 *    Env:    HDREFL=0       turn the reflection enhancement off (for A/B)
 *            HD_ROAD=0.5    road reflection: multiple of the back buffer.  2026-10-15
 *                           1.0 -> 0.5: holds 120 fps in a 3024x1964 race at
 *                           ~2.5 W less (energy per frame -17%); the image
 *                           difference is next to none (with ray tracing on,
 *                           this texture is only a blurred fallback).  Making
 *                           the cube/mirror smaller gave no further gain.
 *            HD_MIRROR=1024 mirror edge (pixels)
 *            HD_CUBE=512    cube face edge (pixels)
 *            HD_BLUR=0.5    road reflection blur: 1 = the game's own
 *                           width, 0 = sharp (see below)
 *
 * 2) ROAD REFLECTION BLUR
 *    The game blurs the reflection in two passes with ps 19 (13->14->13):
 *    4 samples, offsets fixed in UV relative to 320 pixels.  With the texture
 *    grown to 1920 the samples landed 6 pixels apart and a vertical stripe
 *    pattern appeared.  Fix: a mip chain on the reflection targets; the blur
 *    pass reads level L and scales the sample offsets about the center by
 *    s = 2^L / scale.  The sample spacing is then always ~1 texel:
 *      HD_BLUR=1 -> L = log2(scale), s = 1: the game's blur width
 *      HD_BLUR=0 -> L = 0, s = 1/scale: a thin blur at full resolution
 *
 * 3) MSAA (code in metal.m, "HD: MSAA for the screen")
 *    HD_MSAA=4 (default; 2/8 also work, 0/1 off).  Only the SCREEN passes
 *    are multisampled; each pass is resolved into the drawable with
 *    StoreAndMultisampleResolve.  A multisampled twin of Z is kept and its
 *    depth is also RESOLVED into the single-sample Z (HD_ZRESOLVE=0 turns
 *    that off): the game's depth-tested full-screen quad (ps 17 / vs 11, to
 *    a 1920x1080 target) has to see the scene's depth.  Without the resolve,
 *    ~11 draws per frame were measured doing a Z test on an offscreen target.
 *
 * 4) SSR + reflection separation (metal.m "HD: SSR", vsemu.c ps_to_msl_ex2,
 *    camera: overrides.c sub_005c7ec0).  HD_SSR=0 off, HD_SSR_DEBUG=1.
 *
 * 5) RAY-TRACED REFLECTION (metal.m "RT kernel" + "STATIC SCENE CACHE",
 *    the vsk_N compute kernel of vsemu.c vs_to_msl).  macOS 13+.
 *    For road and car pixels the reflection ray is cast into the real scene
 *    geometry; a hit is shaded with the game's own material (texture, vertex
 *    color, headlight term, fog, alpha test).  Miss -> the game's own reflection.
 *      HD_RT=0         off (falls back to SSR)
 *      HD_RT_SCALE=1..4 ray resolution divisor; if not given, AUTOMATIC (by
 *                      width: 1080p 2, 2560/3024 3, 4K 4)
 *      HD_RT_CACHE=0   turn the static scene cache off (behind the camera is lost)
 *      HD_RT_MAXD=600  ray range (world units ~ meters)
 *      HD_RT_LOD=0.05  texture mip by distance
 *      HD_RT_FIX=0     turn the vertex check off (triangles with NaN / infinite /
 *                      over-100-km vertices poison the acceleration structure)
 *    Diagnostics: HD_SSR_DEBUG=4 (reflection only), HD_RT_LOG=1/2,
 *    HD_RT_DUMPTAB=<frame>, HD_RT_STRESS=<N>, HD_RT_STAGE/NOTEX/PLAIN, HD_RTPROBE.
 *
 * 6) GPU BUDGET (metal.m "MSAA: needless store / resolve", "DEFER THE PASS
 *    THAT SPLITS THE SCENE").  5 multisampled screen passes per frame cut to 1.
 *      HD_MSLAZY=0     lazy store/resolve off (old behavior)
 *      HD_REORDER=0    intermediate-pass deferral off
 *    Measurement (both builds): GPUWIN=a,b  PASSPROF=N [PASSPROF_MODE=1]
 *    HD only: HD_COMP=0  HD_RT_AB=1.                                         */

static uint32_t clampu(double v){
    if (v < 16.0) return 16u;
    if (v > 8192.0) return 8192u;
    return (uint32_t)(v + 0.5);
}
static const char *opt(const char *name){
    const char *e = getenv(name);
    return (e && *e) ? e : NULL;
}
/* "1" is not off: it is a number (road_reflection = 1 is the full render size) */
static int is_off(const char *v){
    return !strcasecmp(v, "off") || !strcasecmp(v, "original") || !strcasecmp(v, "game") ||
           !strcmp(v, "0") || !strcasecmp(v, "no") || !strcasecmp(v, "false");
}
/* The values are the ones settings.ini accepts (bundle.m), so a value means the
 * same in the file and in the environment. */
/* msaa = off | 2 | 4 | auto (8 only in the research build); 1 sample is off */
static void opt_msaa(const char *v){
    if (!strcasecmp(v, "auto")){ g_msaa = 4; g_msaa_auto = 1; return; }
    if (is_off(v) || !strcmp(v, "1")){ g_msaa = 1; g_msaa_auto = 0; return; }
    int n = atoi(v);
    if (n == 2 || n == 4 || (NFS_ENHANCED && n == 8)){ g_msaa = n; g_msaa_auto = 0; return; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[gfx] msaa \"%s\" not one of off|2|4|auto, ignored\n", v);
}
/* mirror = original | high (1024) | <edge px> */
static void opt_mirror(const char *v){
    if (is_off(v)){ g_mirror = 0; return; }
    if (!strcasecmp(v, "high")){ g_mirror = 1024u; return; }
    double d = atof(v);
    if (d >= 64.0 && d <= 4096.0){ g_mirror = clampu(d); return; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[gfx] mirror \"%s\" not one of original|high|64..4096, ignored\n", v);
}
#if NFS_ENHANCED
/* road_reflection = original | high (0.5 x back buffer) | <factor>: research build only */
static void opt_road(const char *v){
    if (is_off(v)){ g_road = 0.0; return; }
    if (!strcasecmp(v, "high")){ g_road = 0.5; return; }
    double d = atof(v);
    if (d >= 0.1 && d <= 1.0){ g_road = d; return; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[gfx] road_reflection \"%s\" not one of original|high|0.1..1, ignored\n", v);
}
#endif
static void opt_aniso(const char *v){
    if (is_off(v)){ g_aniso = 0; return; }
    if (!strcasecmp(v, "anisotropic")){ g_aniso = 1; return; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[gfx] texture_filtering \"%s\" not one of game|anisotropic, ignored\n", v);
}

static void enh_init_once(void){
    const char *e;
#if NFS_ENHANCED
    /* research build: upstream's variables first */
    if ((e = opt("HDREFL")) && *e == '0'){ g_road = 0.0; g_mirror = 0; g_cube = 0; }
    else {
        if ((e = opt("HD_ROAD")))   g_road   = atof(e) > 0.0 ? atof(e) : 0.5;
        if ((e = opt("HD_MIRROR"))) g_mirror = clampu(atof(e));
        if ((e = opt("HD_CUBE")))   g_cube   = clampu(atof(e));
    }
    if ((e = opt("HD_MSAA"))){ int n = atoi(e); g_msaa_auto = 0;
        g_msaa = (n == 2 || n == 4 || n == 8) ? n : 1; }
#endif
    if ((e = opt("HD_BLUR"))) g_blur = atof(e);
    if (g_blur < 0.0) g_blur = 0.0;
    if (g_blur > 1.0) g_blur = 1.0;

    const char *km = opt("NFSU2_MSAA"), *ki = opt("NFSU2_MIRROR"),
               *kt = opt("NFSU2_TEXTURE_FILTERING"), *kg = opt("NFSU2_GRAPHICS");
#if NFS_ENHANCED
    const char *kr = opt("NFSU2_ROAD_REFLECTION");
#else
    const char *kr = NULL;
    if (opt("NFSU2_ROAD_REFLECTION"))
        fprintf(stderr, "[gfx] NFSU2_ROAD_REFLECTION ignored: the larger road reflection is only in the "
                        "research build (no improvement on the original look)\n");
#endif
    const char *preset = kg ? kg : (km || kr || ki || kt) ? "custom" : "original";
    if (strcasecmp(preset, "original") && strcasecmp(preset, "enhanced") && strcasecmp(preset, "custom")){
        fprintf(stderr, "[gfx] graphics \"%s\" not one of original|enhanced|custom: original\n", preset);
        preset = "original";
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(preset, "enhanced")){
        /* the recommended set */
        g_msaa = 4; g_msaa_auto = 1; g_mirror = 1024u; g_aniso = 1;
    }
    if (strcasecmp(preset, "original")){
        if (km) opt_msaa(km);
        if (ki) opt_mirror(ki);
#if NFS_ENHANCED
        if (kr) opt_road(kr);
#endif
        if (kt) opt_aniso(kt);
    } else if ((km && !is_off(km)) || (kr && !is_off(kr)) || (ki && !is_off(ki)) || (kt && !is_off(kt)))
        fprintf(stderr, "[gfx] graphics = original: msaa / mirror / texture_filtering ignored "
                        "(graphics = custom uses them)\n");
    if (NFS_ENHANCED || strcasecmp(preset, "original")){
        char ms[16], rd[80] = "";
        snprintf(ms, sizeof ms, g_msaa > 1 ? (g_msaa_auto ? "auto" : "%dx") : "off", g_msaa);
        if (NFS_ENHANCED && g_road > 0.0)
            snprintf(rd, sizeof rd, ", road reflection %.2fx back buffer (blur %.2f)", g_road, g_blur);
        else if (NFS_ENHANCED) snprintf(rd, sizeof rd, ", road reflection original");
        fprintf(stderr, "[gfx] graphics %s%s: msaa %s, mirror %s%u%s, texture filtering %s\n",
                NFS_ENHANCED ? "(research build, HD_* defaults) " : "", preset, ms,
                g_mirror ? "" : "original ", g_mirror ? g_mirror : 256u, rd, g_aniso ? "anisotropic" : "game");
    }
#if NFS_ENHANCED
    fprintf(stderr, "[HD] reflections: road=%.2fx back buffer  blur=%.2f  mirror=%u  cube=%u\n",
            g_road, g_blur, g_mirror, g_cube);
#endif
}
static void enh_init(void){
    static pthread_once_t once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
    pthread_once(&once, enh_init_once);
}

const char *enh_build_name(void){ return NFS_ENHANCED ? "HD" : "original"; }
float enh_blur(void){ enh_init(); return (float)g_blur; }
int   enh_aniso(void){ enh_init(); return g_aniso; }
int   enh_msaa_samples(int *autop){
    enh_init();
    if (autop) *autop = g_msaa > 1 && g_msaa_auto;
    return g_msaa;
}

int enh_rt_size(uint32_t ret, uint32_t bb_w, uint32_t bb_h,
                uint32_t *w, uint32_t *h){
    enh_init();
    int k, kind;
    uint32_t nw, nh;
    switch (ret){
    case RET_ROAD: case RET_ROAD_BLUR:
        /* Not the expected size (another version/patch): leave it alone. */
        if (g_road <= 0.0 || *w != 320u || *h != 240u) return ENH_NONE;
        k  = (ret == RET_ROAD) ? 0 : 1; kind = ENH_ROAD;
        nw = clampu(bb_w * g_road); nh = clampu(bb_h * g_road);
        break;
    case RET_MIRROR:
        if (!g_mirror || *w != 256u || *h != 256u) return ENH_NONE;
        k = 2; kind = ENH_MIRROR; nw = nh = g_mirror;
        break;
    case RET_CUBE:
        if (!g_cube || *w != 128u) return ENH_NONE;
        k = 3; kind = ENH_CUBE; nw = nh = g_cube;
        break;
    default:
        return ENH_NONE;
    }
    if (g_hits[k] < 3 || g_last_w[k] != nw || g_last_h[k] != nh){
        static const char *nm[4] = { "road reflection", "road blur",
                                     "rear-view mirror", "cube map" };
        fprintf(stderr, "[HD] %s %ux%u -> %ux%u\n", nm[k], *w, *h, nw, nh);
    }
    g_hits[k]++; g_last_w[k] = nw; g_last_h[k] = nh;
    *w = nw; *h = nh;
    return kind;
}

#if NFS_ENHANCED
/* Pass the main view's (id 1) matrices to Metal as frame data. */
void enh_view_setup(uint32_t id, const float *m, uint32_t cam){
    (void)cam;
    /* VIEWLOG=1: the view matrix (3x3 + position) of every view id, once
     * per id after its 4000th call.  For reading the axes of the cube face
     * cameras. */
    { static int vl = -1; static unsigned cnt[32]; static unsigned char done[32];
      if (vl < 0) vl = getenv("VIEWLOG") ? 1 : 0;
      if (vl && id < 32u && !done[id] && ++cnt[id] > 4000u){ done[id] = 1;
          fprintf(stderr, "[view %u] right=(%.3f %.3f %.3f) y=(%.3f %.3f %.3f) forward=(%.3f %.3f %.3f) P00=%.3f P11=%.3f\n",
                  id, m[0], m[4], m[8], m[1], m[5], m[9], m[2], m[6], m[10], m[16], m[21]); } }
    /* The cube map face cameras (views 16..21) are aligned NOT to the world
     * axes but to another frame (measured).  To turn the cube sampling vector
     * into world space, the face cameras' forward directions: cube +x = view 17,
     * +y = view 18, +z = view 21 (measured: right/back/up on the car;
     * confirmed with the HD_SSR_DEBUG=3 normal agreement test). */
    static float cube_b[9] = { 1,0,0, 0,1,0, 0,0,1 };
    if (id == 17u || id == 18u || id == 21u){
        int a = (id == 17u) ? 0 : (id == 18u) ? 1 : 2;
        cube_b[a*3] = m[2]; cube_b[a*3+1] = m[6]; cube_b[a*3+2] = m[10];
        return;
    }
    if (id != 1u) return;
    void metal_hd_set_camera(const float *m48, float k, const float *cube9);
    float com_aspfix(void);
    metal_hd_set_camera(m, com_aspfix(), cube_b);
}

#endif /* NFS_ENHANCED */

void enh_report(void){
    if (!g_hits[0] && !g_hits[1] && !g_hits[2] && !g_hits[3]) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "[HD] reflection targets: road=%u blur=%u mirror=%u cube=%u"
            " (last: road %ux%u, mirror %u, cube %u)\n",
            g_hits[0], g_hits[1], g_hits[2], g_hits[3],
            g_last_w[0], g_last_h[0], g_last_w[2], g_last_w[3]);
}

/* Graphics enhancements.
 *
 * Optional graphics, every build (runtime options, all off by default; the
 * default frame is the original's, bit for bit):
 *   NFSU2_GRAPHICS          original | enhanced | custom      (settings.ini graphics)
 *   NFSU2_MSAA              off | 2 | 4 | auto                (msaa)
 *   NFSU2_MIRROR            original | high | <edge px>       (mirror)
 *   NFSU2_TEXTURE_FILTERING game | anisotropic                (texture_filtering)
 *
 * The unshipped research build (./link.sh hd -> out/nfsu2_hd_boot, NFS_ENHANCED=1)
 * adds the larger road reflection (NFSU2_ROAD_REFLECTION there), upstream's SSR,
 * ray-traced reflections and the larger cube map, with upstream's defaults
 * (HD_* variables).  They were measured and rejected for
 * the shipped app.
 *
 * Principle: do not touch the game's logic.  The game keeps seeing its own
 * sizes (GetDesc says 320x240); only the real texture in Metal grows.
 * The viewport is already set to the whole target, so the scene fills the
 * large texture, and sampling is in UV space, so it is size-independent.  */
#ifndef ENHANCE_H
#define ENHANCE_H
#include <stdint.h>

#ifndef NFS_ENHANCED
#define NFS_ENHANCED 0
#endif

enum { ENH_NONE = 0, ENH_ROAD = 1, ENH_MIRROR = 2, ENH_CUBE = 3 };

/* Render target size: enlarges the (w,h) the game asked for based on the
 * CALLING address.  ret = return address of the COM call (c->eip).  Returns
 * the target kind (ENH_*); ENH_NONE if it left the size alone. */
int  enh_rt_size(uint32_t ret, uint32_t bb_w, uint32_t bb_h,
                 uint32_t *w, uint32_t *h);
/* Road reflection blur: 1 = the game's original width, 0 = sharp. */
float enh_blur(void);
/* MSAA sample count asked for (1 = off, 2, 4; 8 only in the research build);
 * *autop (optional) = 1 when the count follows the drawable (2x at >= 1400
 * rows, 4x below). */
int  enh_msaa_samples(int *autop);
/* 1 = texture_filtering = anisotropic: a linear sampler the game gives a
 * MAXANISOTROPY above 1 filters anisotropically, as the game's own
 * g_TextureFiltering = 2 does (metal.m samp_for). */
int  enh_aniso(void);
void enh_report(void);
const char *enh_build_name(void);
#if NFS_ENHANCED
/* View setup (overrides.c, sub_005c7ec0): id = eView id,
 * m = 48 floats (view, projection, product; row-vector layout),
 * cam = guest Camera* (may be 0). */
void enh_view_setup(uint32_t id, const float *m, uint32_t cam);
#else
static inline void enh_view_setup(uint32_t id, const float *m, uint32_t cam)
{ (void)id; (void)m; (void)cam; }
#endif

#endif

/* features.c -- the runtime's features in one place: what each installs at
 * boot, its instruction hooks, its calls every frame.
 *
 * Three lists, each run in its own order, as their calls depend on it: the
 * installs in the boot's, the hook chain stops at the first hook that takes
 * the address, the frame calls run one after another from the main loop's
 * hook.  A row per feature with all three would not keep them: roam.c's hook
 * comes before language.c's and its frame call after; damage.c's hook is the
 * last, its frame call the first.
 *
 * Every build has the same hooks and frame calls; the installs say which
 * builds run them at boot (FT_WEB: web/build.sh, FT_MAC: link.sh). */

#include <stddef.h>

enum { FT_WEB = 1, FT_MAC = 2, FT_ALL = FT_WEB | FT_MAC };
#ifdef __wasm__
#define FT_HERE FT_WEB
#else
#define FT_HERE FT_MAC
#endif
#define COUNT(a) (sizeof (a) / sizeof (a)[0])

void features_install(void){
    for (size_t i = 0; i < COUNT(k_installs); i++)

/* Guest file I/O -> POSIX.  Maps Windows paths to the game folder and
 * resolves them case-insensitively.                                    */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <strings.h>
#include <ctype.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static uint64_t now_ns_io(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec*1000000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
}

void mem_commit(uint32_t,uint32_t);

static char g_root[1024] = ".";
static char g_cwd_rel[512] = "";           /* current directory inside the game */
uint64_t g_file_open=0, g_file_fail=0, g_file_read=0, g_bytes_read=0;
uint64_t g_overlapped_reads=0;
static int g_empty_next = 0;

void fileio_set_root(const char *exe_path){
    strncpy(g_root, exe_path, sizeof g_root - 1);
    char *slash = strrchr(g_root, '/');
    if (slash) *slash = 0; else strcpy(g_root, ".");
    fprintf(stderr,"file: game root folder = %s\n", g_root);
}

/* Turn a Windows path into a real path.
 *   "C:\\NFSU2\\TRACKS\\X.BUN" | "TRACKS\\X.BUN" | ".\\X" -> <root>/TRACKS/X.BUN
 * The virtual game folder is "C:\\NFSU2", so that prefix is dropped.
 * Components are resolved case-insensitively.                          */
/* For opens meant for writing, create the missing parent folders (on Windows
 * the game creates them separately; here the whole path must be ready). */
static void mkparents(const char *path){
    char tmp[1024]; snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s", path);
    for (char *q = tmp + 1; *q; q++){
        if (*q != '/') continue;
        *q = 0; mkdir(tmp, 0755); *q = '/';
    }
}

/* Drop "." and empty components and resolve ".." lexically, never above the
 * root: "..\\..\\x" must not reach outside the game folder (or the save
 * overlay), whatever the guest asks for. */
static void rel_normalize(char *rel){
    char tmp[1024]; snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s", rel);
    size_t k = 0; char *save = 0;
    for (char *tok = strtok_r(tmp, "/", &save); tok; tok = strtok_r(0, "/", &save)){
        if (!strcmp(tok, ".")) continue;
        if (!strcmp(tok, "..")){
            while (k > 0 && rel[k-1] != '/') k--;
            if (k > 0) k--;
            continue; }
        size_t l = strlen(tok);
        if (k + l + 2 > sizeof tmp) break;
        if (k) rel[k++] = '/';
        memcpy(rel + k, tok, l); k += l;
    }
    rel[k] = 0;
}

/* the guest path relative to the game folder, '/'-separated and normalized */
static void rel_of(const char *win, char *rel, size_t relsz){
    size_t k=0;
    const char *p = win;
    if (p[0] && p[1]==':') p += 2;                       /* drive letter   */
    while (*p=='\\' || *p=='/') p++;
    if (!strncasecmp(p,"NFSU2",5) && (p[5]=='\\'||p[5]=='/'||p[5]==0)){
        p += 5; while (*p=='\\'||*p=='/') p++;           /* virtual root   */
    }
    while (p[0]=='.' && (p[1]=='\\'||p[1]=='/')) p += 2;
    for (; *p && k<relsz-1; p++) rel[k++] = (*p=='\\') ? '/' : *p;
    rel[k]=0;
    rel_normalize(rel);
}
static int resolve_in(const char *root, const char *win, char *out, size_t outsz){
    char rel[1024];
    rel_of(win, rel, sizeof rel);
    if (!rel[0]){ snprintf(out,outsz,"%s",root); return 1; }

    snprintf(out, outsz, "%s/%s", root, rel);
    struct stat st;
    if (stat(out, &st)==0) return 1;

    /* component by component, case-insensitive */
    char cur[1024]; snprintf(cur, sizeof cur, "%s", root);
    char tmp[1024]; snprintf(tmp,sizeof tmp,"%s",rel);
    char *save=0; int missing=0;
    for (char *tok=strtok_r(tmp,"/",&save); tok; tok=strtok_r(0,"/",&save)){
        if (missing){ size_t l=strlen(cur); snprintf(cur+l,sizeof cur-l,"/%s",tok); continue; }
        char cand[1024]; snprintf(cand,sizeof cand,"%s/%s",cur,tok);
        if (stat(cand,&st)==0){ snprintf(cur,sizeof cur,"%s",cand); continue; }
        DIR *d = opendir(cur); int found=0;
        if (d){ struct dirent *e;
            while ((e=readdir(d))){
                if (!strcasecmp(e->d_name, tok)){
                    snprintf(cand,sizeof cand,"%s/%s",cur,e->d_name);
                    found=1; break; } }
            closedir(d); }
        if (found) snprintf(cur,sizeof cur,"%s",cand);
        else { snprintf(cand,sizeof cand,"%s/%s",cur,tok);
               snprintf(cur,sizeof cur,"%s",cand); missing=1; }
    }
    snprintf(out,outsz,"%s",cur);
    return !missing;
}

/* --- write root (save overlay) ------------------------------------------
 * The game writes its saves and profiles into ITS OWN folder.  With the data
 * embedded inside the .app, writing there breaks the bundle's signature; the
 * saves would also be wiped when the app is updated.  If a write root is set:
 *   - write / create / delete always go to the write root,
 *   - reads look in the write root first, otherwise in the game root,
 *   - a directory listing is the union of both.
 * If it is not set (from a terminal, or a bundle with its data outside)
 * everything stays in the single root as before. */
static char g_wroot[1024] = "";
void fileio_set_write_root(const char *dir){
    if (!dir || !*dir){ g_wroot[0] = 0; return; }
    snprintf(g_wroot, sizeof g_wroot, "%s", dir);
    mkparents(g_wroot); mkdir(g_wroot, 0755);
    fprintf(stderr,"file: save folder = %s\n", g_wroot);
}
/* runtime/module.c: a file in the game folder itself (never the save
 * overlay), such as server.dll; 0 if it does not exist. */
int fileio_resolve_game(const char *win, char *out, size_t outsz){
    struct stat st;
    return resolve_in(g_root, win, out, outsz) && stat(out, &st) == 0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode);
}
/* The save overlay holds what the game wrote (its profile folder) and the
 * runtime's own files, yet every read looked there first.  In the browser each
 * step of that is a round trip to the I/O worker and an OPFS call (a stat,
 * then a listing of the overlay root for the case-insensitive match): ~1.5 to
 * 2 ms per open with the guest lock held, and a race streams its track by
 * opening TRACKS\STREAM*.BUN again and again, from the game thread too, which
 * cost it 120 Hz slots.  So whether the overlay root has a folder of the game
 * root (TRACKS, CARS, ...; the runtime makes none of those there) is
 * remembered until the next write-side operation (write_allowed). */
static unsigned g_ov_gen = 1;
#define OVC_N 64
static struct { char name[64]; unsigned gen; signed char game_dir, in_ov; } g_ovc[OVC_N];
static int g_ovc_n;
static uint64_t g_ovc_skips;
static int overlay_cannot_have(const char *win){
    char rel[1024]; rel_of(win, rel, sizeof rel);
    char *sl = strchr(rel, '/');
    if (!sl) return 0;                                   /* a file at the top: always looked up */
    *sl = 0;
    if (!rel[0] || strlen(rel) >= sizeof g_ovc[0].name) return 0;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < g_ovc_n && strcasecmp(g_ovc[i].name, rel); i++) {}
    if (i == g_ovc_n){
        if (g_ovc_n == OVC_N) return 0;
        snprintf(g_ovc[i].name, sizeof g_ovc[i].name, "%s", rel);
        char p[1100]; struct stat st;
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", g_root, rel);
        g_ovc[i].game_dir = stat(p, &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode);   /* the game folder never changes */
        g_ovc[i].gen = 0; g_ovc_n++;
    }
    if (!g_ovc[i].game_dir) return 0;
    if (g_ovc[i].gen != g_ov_gen){
        char w[1100];
        g_ovc[i].in_ov = (signed char)resolve_in(g_wroot, rel, w, sizeof w);
        g_ovc[i].gen = g_ov_gen;
    }
    if (g_ovc[i].in_ov) return 0;
    g_ovc_skips++;
    return 1;
}
/* --- language pack (runtime/language.c) ---------------------------------
 * LANGPACKS/<language> in the game folder holds the files a language plays
 * with in place of the game folder's: a file there is read instead of the
 * game's file of the same path (case-insensitive), as long as the save
 * overlay has no copy of its own.  Its list is read once, so every other
 * open costs nothing more. */
static char g_lroot[1024];
struct lfile { char *key, *rel; };
struct flist { struct lfile *f; int n, cap; };        /* sorted by key: the path lower-cased */
static struct flist g_lp;
static int lfile_cmp(const void *a, const void *b){
    return strcmp(((const struct lfile *)a)->key, ((const struct lfile *)b)->key);
}
static void lpack_walk(struct flist *l, const char *dir, const char *rel){
    DIR *d = opendir(dir); if (!d) return;
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))){
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        char p[1100], r[1024]; struct stat st;
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, e->d_name);
        snprintf(r, sizeof r, "%s%s%s", rel, rel[0] ? "/" : "", e->d_name);
        if (stat(p, &st) != 0) continue;
        if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)){ lpack_walk(l, p, r); continue; }
        if (!S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) continue;
        if (l->n == l->cap){
            l->cap = l->cap ? 2*l->cap : 64;
            struct lfile *nf = realloc(l->f, (size_t)l->cap * sizeof *l->f); if (!nf) break;
            l->f = nf;
        }
        l->f[l->n].rel = strdup(r); l->f[l->n].key = strdup(r);
        for (char *k = l->f[l->n].key; *k; k++) *k = (char)tolower((unsigned char)*k);
        l->n++;
    }
    closedir(d);
}
static const struct lfile *flist_find(const struct flist *l, const char *win){
    if (!l->n) return 0;
    char rel[1024]; rel_of(win, rel, sizeof rel);
    for (char *k = rel; *k; k++) *k = (char)tolower((unsigned char)*k);
    struct lfile key = { rel, 0 };
    return bsearch(&key, l->f, (size_t)l->n, sizeof *l->f, lfile_cmp);
}
/* -> how many files the pack has (0: none, or no such folder) */
int fileio_set_language_pack(const char *rel){
    if (!resolve_in(g_root, rel, g_lroot, sizeof g_lroot)) return 0;
    lpack_walk(&g_lp, g_lroot, "");
    qsort(g_lp.f, (size_t)g_lp.n, sizeof *g_lp.f, lfile_cmp);
    return g_lp.n;
}
static int lpack_resolve(const char *win, char *out, size_t outsz){
    const struct lfile *f = flist_find(&g_lp, win);
    if (!f) return 0;
    snprintf(out, outsz, "%s/%s", g_lroot, f->rel);
    return 1;
}

/* Read: the write root if the file is there, then the language pack, otherwise the game root. */
static int resolve(const char *win, char *out, size_t outsz){

        char w[1024];
        if (resolve_in(g_wroot, win, w, sizeof w) && strcmp(w, g_wroot) != 0){
            snprintf(out, outsz, "%s", w); return 1; }

    if (lpack_resolve(win, out, outsz)) return 1;

}

static int is_profile(const char *path){
    static const char dir[] = "NFS Underground 2";
    const char *b = strrchr(path, '/'), *d, *e;
    if (!b || b == path) return 0;
    for (d = b - 1; d > path && *d != '/'; d--) {}
    if (*d != '/' || d == path) return 0;
    size_t n = (size_t)(b - d - 1);
    if (!n || strlen(b + 1) != n || strncasecmp(d + 1, b + 1, n)) return 0;
    for (e = d - 1; e > path && *e != '/'; e--) {}
    return *e == '/' && (size_t)(d - e - 1) == sizeof dir - 1 && !strncasecmp(e + 1, dir, sizeof dir - 1);
}
static int copy_file(const char *a, const char *b){
    FILE *fa = fopen(a, "rb"); if (!fa) return 0;
    mkparents(b);
    FILE *fb = fopen(b, "wb"); if (!fb){ fclose(fa); return 0; }
    char bufr[65536]; size_t k;
    while ((k = fread(bufr, 1, sizeof bufr, fa)) > 0) fwrite(bufr, 1, k, fb);
    fclose(fb); fclose(fa); return 1;
}
/* If a file to be written without truncation exists only in the game root,
 * copy it to the write root first; otherwise the game writes over an empty file. */

    struct stat st; if (stat(wpath, &st) == 0) return;
    char src[1024];
    if (resolve_in(g_root, win, src, sizeof src) && stat(src, &st) == 0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode))
        copy_file(src, wpath);
}

/* --- write audit and read-only game folder ------------------------------
 * Every write-side operation (write-mode open, delete, mkdir, rmdir,
 * move/copy target, attribute change) is logged as "[write] <op> <guest> -> <host>",
 * so any run shows exactly what the game writes and where.  With
 * fileio_set_readonly_root(1) (the .app, which runs against the user's
 * original install) a write that would land inside the game folder is
 * refused instead, unless it is inside the save overlay. */
static int g_ro_root = 0;
static uint64_t g_wr_ops = 0, g_wr_blocked = 0, g_wr_in_root = 0;
