    float sag;                       /* pitch x (1 - sag (1 - envelope)): an air horn's rise to pitch and fall, the Klaxon's sweep */

     * diaphragm and trumpet), or with wah a low-pass that opens by wah Hz
     * with each note (a trombone's mute) */
    float res, wah;

    const Note *tune; int ntune;     /* the tones play this tune, over again */
    float gate, nsag, vib;           /* the tune: each note's rise and fall (s, 0: 4 ms), its pitch x (1 - nsag (1 - that)), the vibrato's depth */
    /* 1: no tones but horns.dat's clip of this name (only att, rel and level
     * count); again: s of silence before it plays again while held (a clip
     * with a loop loops instead) */
    int   clip; float again;
} Kind;

/* ---- the recorded horns: web/src/static/horns.dat (web/tools/mkhorns.mjs) ---------- */
#pragma clang diagnostic push
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wc23-extensions"
static const uint8_t g_horns_bin[] = {
#embed "../web/src/static/horns.dat"
};
#pragma clang diagnostic pop
typedef struct { const uint8_t *pcm; uint32_t n, l0, l1; float rate; } Clip;   /* l1: 0, no loop */
static uint32_t rd16(const uint8_t *p){ return (uint32_t)p[0] | (uint32_t)p[1] << 8; }
static uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t *p){ return rd16(p) | rd16(p + 2) << 16; }
/* the clip of that name; 0 (n 0) when horns.dat has none (the kind sounds as the dual horn) */
static int clip_find(const char *name, Clip *c){
    const uint8_t *b = g_horns_bin;
    uint32_t len = (uint32_t)sizeof g_horns_bin, cnt = len >= 8 ? rd16(b + 4) : 0, head = 8u + 32u * cnt;
    memset(c, 0, sizeof *c);
    if (len < 8 || memcmp(b, "HRN1", 4) || head > len) return 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cnt; i++){
        const uint8_t *e = b + 8 + 32 * i;
        if (strncmp((const char *)e, name, 16)) continue;
        uint32_t off = rd32(e + 16), n = rd32(e + 20), l0 = rd32(e + 24), l1 = rd32(e + 28);
        if (!n || off > (len - head) / 2 || n > (len - head) / 2 - off || l1 > n || (l1 && l0 + 4 > l1)) return 0;
        c->pcm = b + head + 2 * off; c->n = n; c->l0 = l0; c->l1 = l1; c->rate = (float)rd16(b + 6);
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
/* sample i (past a loop's end: from its start again; outside the clip: 0) */
static inline float clip_s(const Clip *c, int64_t i){
    if (c->l1 && i >= (int64_t)c->l1) i -= c->l1 - c->l0;
    if (i < 0 || i >= (int64_t)c->n) return 0.f;
    return (float)(int16_t)rd16(c->pcm + 2 * i) * (1.f / 32768.f);
}
/* between samples i and i + 1, t of the way (a cubic through i - 1 .. i + 2) */
static inline float clip_at(const Clip *c, uint32_t i, float t){
    float xm = clip_s(c, (int64_t)i - 1), x0 = clip_s(c, i), x1 = clip_s(c, (int64_t)i + 1), x2 = clip_s(c, (int64_t)i + 2);
    float c1 = 0.5f * (x1 - xm), c2 = xm - 2.5f * x0 + 2.f * x1 - 0.5f * x2, c3 = 0.5f * (x2 - xm) + 1.5f * (x0 - x1);
    return ((c3 * t + c2) * t + c1) * t + x0;
}

const char *horn_name(int kind){ return KINDS[kind >= 0 && kind < HORN_KINDS ? kind : 0].name; }
int horn_mine(void){
    static int mine = -1;
    if (mine < 0){
        const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_HORN");
        mine = 0;
        for (int k = 0; e && *e && k < HORN_KINDS; k++) if (!strcasecmp(e, KINDS[k].name)) mine = k;
        if (e && *e && strcasecmp(e, KINDS[mine].name)) fprintf(stderr, "[horn] NFSU2_HORN=%s: no such horn, the dual one\n", e);
        else fprintf(stderr, "[horn] my horn: %s\n", KINDS[mine].name);
    }
    return mine;
}
/* how long a voice let go takes to fade out (to -80 dB) before another horn takes it */
static uint32_t tail_ms(int kind){ return (uint32_t)(9.3f * KINDS[kind].rel * 1000.f) + 120u; }

static uint32_t now_ms(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint32_t)((uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000u + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000000u);
}
static uint32_t fnv1a(const char *s){
    uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
    for (; s && *s; s++){ h ^= (uint8_t)*s; h *= 16777619u; }
    return h;
}
static int g_logged;
#define HLOG(...) do { if (__atomic_add_fetch(&g_logged, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) <= 40) fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__); } while (0)

/* ---- game thread -> mixer: one word per field ------------------------------------ */
static struct { uint32_t tune, kind, gain, pan, pitch, stamp; } g_in[HORN_VOICES];
static uint32_t fbits(float f){ uint32_t u; memcpy(&u, &f, 4); return u; }
static float bitsf(uint32_t u){ float f; memcpy(&f, &u, 4); return f; }
#define PUT(f, v) __atomic_store_n(&(f), (v), __ATOMIC_RELAXED)
#define GET(f)    __atomic_load_n(&(f), __ATOMIC_RELAXED)
static void voice_set(int v, uint32_t tune, int kind, float gain, float pan, float pitch){
    PUT(g_in[v].tune, tune); PUT(g_in[v].kind, (uint32_t)kind); PUT(g_in[v].gain, fbits(gain)); PUT(g_in[v].pan, fbits(pan));
    PUT(g_in[v].pitch, fbits(pitch)); PUT(g_in[v].stamp, now_ms());
}
/* the volume and the game's Master Volume, as the mixer reads them: 1.0's
 * bits until the slider sets the one and the game thread reads the other */
static uint32_t g_vol = 0x3f800000u, g_master = 0x3f800000u;
void horn_set_volume(float v){
    if (!(v >= HORN_VOL_MIN)) v = HORN_VOL_MIN;
    if (v > 1.f) v = 1.f;
    PUT(g_vol, fbits(v));
}
/* photo mode's Horns off: every horn quiet while it is on (the voices fade as the volume does) */
static uint32_t g_mute;
void horn_mute(int on){ PUT(g_mute, on ? 1u : 0u); }
static void master_read(void){
    float m = horn_game_master();
    if (!(m >= 0.f)) m = 0.f;
    if (m > 1.f) m = 1.f;
    if (fbits(m) != GET(g_master)) fprintf(stderr, "[horn] the game's Master Volume at %.0f %%\n", 100.0 * m);
    PUT(g_master, fbits(m));
}

/* ---- the game thread: which horn has which voice ---------------------------------- */
static struct { int used, sounded, kind; uint32_t who, tune, free_at; float pan, pitch; } g_vo[HORN_VOICES];
static struct { int ok; float p[3], l[2], v[3]; } g_lis;
#define PREVIEW_WHO 0xfffffffeu
static char g_self[64];                                  /* the name the player's own horn last sounded with (its pitch) */
void horn_begin(const float *pos, const float *fwd, const float *vel){
    master_read();
    g_lis.ok = pos && fwd;
    if (!g_lis.ok) return;
    for (int a = 0; a < 3; a++){ g_lis.p[a] = pos[a]; g_lis.v[a] = vel ? vel[a] : 0.f; }
    float lx = -fwd[1], ly = fwd[0], ln = sqrtf(lx * lx + ly * ly);   /* the camera's left, level (z is up) */
    if (ln > 0.001f){ g_lis.l[0] = lx / ln; g_lis.l[1] = ly / ln; } else { g_lis.l[0] = 0.f; g_lis.l[1] = 1.f; }
}
int horn_sound(uint32_t who, const char *name, int kind, const float *p, const float *v){
    float gain = SELF, pan = 0.f, pitch = 1.f, dist = 0.f;
    if (kind < 0 || kind >= HORN_KINDS) kind = 0;        /* a newer build's horn */
    if (p){
        if (!g_lis.ok) return -1;
        float d[3] = { p[0] - g_lis.p[0], p[1] - g_lis.p[1], p[2] - g_lis.p[2] };
        dist = sqrtf(d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1] + d[2] * d[2]);
        if (!(dist < FAR_M)) return -1;
        gain = dist > NEAR_M ? NEAR_M / dist : 1.f;
        if (dist > FAR_M - 50.f) gain *= (FAR_M - dist) / 50.f;
        if (dist > 0.1f){
            float vl = 0.f, vs = 0.f;
            pan = -(d[0] * g_lis.l[0] + d[1] * g_lis.l[1]) / dist;
            for (int a = 0; a < 3; a++){ vl += g_lis.v[a] * d[a] / dist; vs += (v ? v[a] : 0.f) * d[a] / dist; }
            /* c + the player's speed towards the horn over c + the horn's speed away */
            pitch = (SOUND_MPS + vl) / (SOUND_MPS + vs);
            if (!(pitch >= 0.5f)) pitch = 0.5f;
            if (pitch > 2.f) pitch = 2.f;
        }
    }
    if (!p && who != PREVIEW_WHO && name) snprintf(g_self, sizeof g_self, "%s", name);
    int k = 0, start = 0;
    uint32_t now = now_ms();
    while (k < HORN_VOICES && !(g_vo[k].used && g_vo[k].who == who)) k++;
    if (k == HORN_VOICES){
        for (k = 0; k < HORN_VOICES; k++) if (!g_vo[k].used && (!g_vo[k].free_at || (int32_t)(now - g_vo[k].free_at) >= 0)) break;
        if (k == HORN_VOICES) return -1;
        g_vo[k].used = 1; g_vo[k].who = who; g_vo[k].tune = fnv1a(name); g_vo[k].kind = kind; g_vo[k].free_at = 0; start = 1;
        if (p) HLOG("[horn] %s's horn, %.0f m away (%s)\n", name && *name ? name : "a player", (double)dist, KINDS[kind].name);
        else HLOG("[horn] my horn (%s)\n", KINDS[kind].name);
    }
    g_vo[k].sounded = 1; g_vo[k].pan = pan; g_vo[k].pitch = pitch;
    voice_set(k, g_vo[k].tune, g_vo[k].kind, gain, pan, pitch);   /* a voice keeps its kind until it is let go */
    return start;
}
void horn_end(void){
    uint32_t now = now_ms();
    for (int k = 0; k < HORN_VOICES; k++){
        if (g_vo[k].sounded){ g_vo[k].sounded = 0; continue; }
        if (g_vo[k].used){ g_vo[k].used = 0; g_vo[k].free_at = now + tail_ms(g_vo[k].kind); }
        voice_set(k, g_vo[k].tune, g_vo[k].kind, 0.f, g_vo[k].pan, g_vo[k].pitch > 0.f ? g_vo[k].pitch : 1.f);   /* fades as it was */
    }
}
/* the player's own horn, sounded once: the mixer lets it go STALE_MS later
 * (or the next horn_end, when free roam or a race has the voices) */
void horn_preview(void){ master_read(); horn_sound(PREVIEW_WHO, g_self, horn_mine(), 0, 0); }

/* ---- the mixer ----------------------------------------------------------------- */
static float g_tbl[HORN_KINDS][TBL + 1];
static Clip g_clip[HORN_KINDS];                          /* the recorded kinds' clips (n 0: none, the dual horn instead) */
static int g_tbl_ok;
static void tbl_init(void){
    for (int h = 0; h < HORN_KINDS; h++){
        const Kind *K = &KINDS[h];
        if (K->clip){
            if (!clip_find(K->name, &g_clip[h])) fprintf(stderr, "[horn] horns.dat has no %s: the dual horn instead\n", K->name);
            continue;
        }
        double peak = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < TBL; i++){
            double x = 2.0 * M_PI * i / TBL, s = 0.0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= K->nh; k++){
                double d = ((double)K->f[0] * k - K->form) / K->width, t = K->top > 0.f ? (double)K->f[0] * k / K->top : 0.0;
                s += sin(k * x) / pow(k, K->roll) * (1.0 + K->lift * exp(-d * d)) * (t > 1.0 ? exp(1.0 - t * t) : 1.0);
            }
            g_tbl[h][i] = (float)s;
            if (fabs(s) > peak) peak = fabs(s);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < TBL; i++) g_tbl[h][i] = (float)(g_tbl[h][i] / peak);
        g_tbl[h][TBL] = g_tbl[h][0];
    }
    g_tbl_ok = 1;
}
static inline float wave(const float *tb, float ph){     /* ph in [0, 1) */
    float x = ph * TBL; int i = (int)x;
    return tb[i] + (tb[i + 1] - tb[i]) * (x - (float)i);
}
static float detune(uint32_t tune){
    static const float k[5] = { 1.f, 0.94f, 1.06f, 0.89f, 1.12f };
    return k[(tune * 2654435761u >> 16) % 5u];
}

static struct {
    int   live, kind;                                    /* sounding or fading out; its kind, kept until it is silent */
    float f[TONES], ph[TONES];                           /* the tones: cycles per sample at pitch 1, phases (cycles) */
    uint32_t age, on[TONES];                             /* samples since the start; when each tone speaks */
    float env, gl, gr, pitch, hx, hy, lp, lo, bd;        /* lo, bd: the resonance (a state-variable filter) */
    int   note; uint32_t left, in;                       /* the tune: the note, samples left of it and into it, */
    float ratio, gate, gs, vph;                          /* its pitch, on/off, that smoothed, the vibrato's phase (cycles) */
    uint32_t rng;
    uint32_t cpos, cwait; float cfrac;                   /* a clip: where it is (sample and fraction); samples of silence before it plays again */
    int   cplay;                                         /* it plays */
    uint32_t frames; float peak[2];                      /* the log line at the end */
} g_v[HORN_VOICES];

void horn_mix(float *acc, unsigned frames, unsigned rate){
    if (!rate || !frames) return;
    if (!g_tbl_ok) tbl_init();
    uint32_t now = now_ms();
    float fs = (float)rate;
    float k_smooth = 1.f - expf(-1.f / (0.020f * fs));
    float k_hp = 1.f / (1.f + 2.f * (float)M_PI * 180.f / fs), rise = 1.f / (0.030f * fs);
    uint32_t gap = (uint32_t)(GAP_S * fs), vib_in = (uint32_t)(0.25f * fs);
    float vol = GET(g_mute) ? 0.f : bitsf(GET(g_vol)) * bitsf(GET(g_master));   /* in the voices' gains, smoothed with them */
    for (int v = 0; v < HORN_VOICES; v++){
        float gain = bitsf(GET(g_in[v].gain));
        if (now - GET(g_in[v].stamp) > STALE_MS) gain = 0.f;
        int held = gain > 0.f;
        if (!g_v[v].live){
            if (!(gain > 0.f)) continue;
            memset(&g_v[v], 0, sizeof g_v[v]);
            g_v[v].live = 1;
            uint32_t kd = GET(g_in[v].kind);
            g_v[v].kind = kd < HORN_KINDS && !(KINDS[kd].clip && !g_clip[kd].n) ? (int)kd : 0;
            float t = detune(GET(g_in[v].tune));            /* a voice keeps its pitch until it is silent */
            for (int i = 0; i < KINDS[g_v[v].kind].n; i++){
                g_v[v].f[i] = KINDS[g_v[v].kind].f[i] * t / fs;
                g_v[v].on[i] = (uint32_t)(KINDS[g_v[v].kind].dly[i] * fs);
            }
            if (KINDS[g_v[v].kind].clip){ g_v[v].f[0] = g_clip[g_v[v].kind].rate * t / fs; g_v[v].cplay = 1; }   /* samples per sample */
            g_v[v].pitch = bitsf(GET(g_in[v].pitch));
            g_v[v].note = -1; g_v[v].ratio = 1.f; g_v[v].rng = 0x9e3779b9u * (uint32_t)(v + 1);
        }
        const Kind *K = &KINDS[g_v[v].kind];
        const float *tb = g_tbl[g_v[v].kind];
        float k_att = 1.f - expf(-1.f / (K->att * fs)), k_rel = 1.f - expf(-1.f / (K->rel * fs));
        float k_gate = 1.f - expf(-1.f / ((K->gate > 0.f ? K->gate : 0.004f) * fs)), dvib = 5.f / fs;
        float svf = K->res > 0.f ? 2.f * sinf((float)M_PI * K->res / fs) : 0.f, wah = 2.f * (float)M_PI * K->wah / fs;
        float pan = bitsf(GET(g_in[v].pan)), tp = bitsf(GET(g_in[v].pitch));
        const Clip *C = K->clip ? &g_clip[g_v[v].kind] : 0;
        uint32_t again = C ? (uint32_t)(K->again * fs) + 1u : 0u;
        if (C && !C->l1){                                  /* a clip without a loop plays again only while held; */
            if (!held) g_v[v].cwait = 0;                   /* let go, it fades out as the others do (env) */
            else if (!g_v[v].cplay && !g_v[v].cwait){ g_v[v].cpos = 0; g_v[v].cfrac = 0.f; g_v[v].cplay = 1; }
        }
        float th = (pan + 1.f) * (float)M_PI * 0.25f;     /* equal power */
        float tgl = gain * cosf(th) * vol, tgr = gain * sinf(th) * vol, te = gain > 0.f ? 1.f : 0.f;
        /* far horns lose their top: a one-pole low-pass from ~1.5 kHz (gain 0.05, 160 m) up to none (gain 0.6) */
        float k_lp = 0.15f + 0.85f * (gain * 1.7f > 1.f ? 1.f : gain * 1.7f);
        float env = g_v[v].env, gl = g_v[v].gl, gr = g_v[v].gr, pt = g_v[v].pitch;
        float hx = g_v[v].hx, hy = g_v[v].hy, lp = g_v[v].lp, lo = g_v[v].lo, bd = g_v[v].bd, pk0 = g_v[v].peak[0], pk1 = g_v[v].peak[1];
        uint32_t age = g_v[v].age;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < frames; i++, age++){
            pt += (tp - pt) * k_smooth;
            float bend = pt, amp = 1.f;
            if (K->sag > 0.f) bend *= 1.f - K->sag * (1.f - env);
            if (K->tune){
                if (!g_v[v].left){
                    const Note *nt = &K->tune[g_v[v].note = (g_v[v].note + 1) % K->ntune];
                    g_v[v].left = (uint32_t)(nt->cs * 0.01f * fs); g_v[v].in = 0;
                    g_v[v].gate = nt->st != REST;
                    if (g_v[v].gate > 0.f) g_v[v].ratio = exp2f(nt->st / 12.f);
                }
                if (g_v[v].left-- <= gap) g_v[v].gate = 0.f;
                float gs = g_v[v].gs += (g_v[v].gate - g_v[v].gs) * k_gate;
                bend *= g_v[v].ratio * (1.f - K->nsag * (1.f - gs)); amp = gs;
                if (K->tune[g_v[v].note].vib && g_v[v].in++ > vib_in){   /* the shake comes in over 0.3 s */
                    float d = (float)(g_v[v].in - vib_in) / (0.3f * fs);
                    if ((g_v[v].vph += dvib) >= 1.f) g_v[v].vph -= 1.f;
                    bend *= 1.f + K->vib * (d < 1.f ? d : 1.f) * sinf(2.f * (float)M_PI * g_v[v].vph);
                }
            }
            float s = 0.f;
            if (C){
                if (g_v[v].cwait){ if (!--g_v[v].cwait){ g_v[v].cpos = 0; g_v[v].cfrac = 0.f; g_v[v].cplay = 1; } }
                else if (g_v[v].cplay){
                    s = clip_at(C, g_v[v].cpos, g_v[v].cfrac);
                    float fr = g_v[v].cfrac + g_v[v].f[0] * bend; uint32_t adv = (uint32_t)fr;
                    g_v[v].cfrac = fr - (float)adv; g_v[v].cpos += adv;
                    if (C->l1){ while (g_v[v].cpos >= C->l1) g_v[v].cpos -= C->l1 - C->l0; }
                    else if (g_v[v].cpos >= C->n){ g_v[v].cplay = 0; if (held) g_v[v].cwait = again; }
                }
                hy = s;                                    /* as recorded: no clip, resonance or high-pass */
            } else {
                for (int t = 0; t < K->n; t++){
                    if (age < g_v[v].on[t]) continue;
                    float *ph = &g_v[v].ph[t];
                    *ph += g_v[v].f[t] * bend; if (*ph >= 1.f) *ph -= 1.f;
                    float w = wave(tb, *ph) * K->a[t], r = (float)(age - g_v[v].on[t]) * rise;
                    if (g_v[v].on[t] && r < 1.f) w *= r;          /* a later trumpet speaks over 30 ms */
                    s += w;
                }
                if (K->hiss > 0.f){
                    uint32_t x = g_v[v].rng; x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >> 17; x ^= x << 5; g_v[v].rng = x;
                    s += K->hiss * ((float)(int32_t)x * (1.f / 2147483648.f));
                }
                s *= K->drive;
                s = s / (1.f + fabsf(s));
                if (svf > 0.f){
                    float fc = svf + wah * amp;                  /* the mute opens with the note */
                    lo += fc * bd; float hi = s - lo - 0.5f * bd; bd += fc * hi;
                    s = K->wah > 0.f ? lo : 0.3f * s + 0.5f * bd;
                }
                hy = k_hp * (hy + s - hx); hx = s;
            }
            lp += (hy - lp) * k_lp;
            env += (te - env) * (te > env ? k_att : k_rel);
            gl += (tgl - gl) * k_smooth; gr += (tgr - gr) * k_smooth;
            float o = lp * (K->swell ? env * sqrtf(env) : env) * amp * LEVEL * K->level, oL = o * gl, oR = o * gr;
            acc[2 * i] += oL; acc[2 * i + 1] += oR;
            if (fabsf(oL) > pk0) pk0 = fabsf(oL);
            if (fabsf(oR) > pk1) pk1 = fabsf(oR);
        }
        g_v[v].env = env; g_v[v].gl = gl; g_v[v].gr = gr; g_v[v].pitch = pt; g_v[v].age = age;
        g_v[v].hx = hx; g_v[v].hy = hy; g_v[v].lp = lp; g_v[v].lo = lo; g_v[v].bd = bd; g_v[v].peak[0] = pk0; g_v[v].peak[1] = pk1;
        g_v[v].frames += frames;
        if (te == 0.f && env < 1e-4f){
            g_v[v].live = 0;
            HLOG("[horn] voice %d (%s): %.2f s, peak left %.1f dBFS, right %.1f dBFS\n", v, K->name, (double)g_v[v].frames / fs,
                 pk0 > 1e-6f ? 20.0 * log10(pk0) : -120.0, pk1 > 1e-6f ? 20.0 * log10(pk1) : -120.0);
        }
    }
}

/* horn.h -- horns between players: the horn key and the horns in the sound
 * output (horn.c).  Free roam (roam_game.c) and network races (racehorn.c)
 * say which horns sound where; the mixers (audio.m, audio_web.c) add them to
 * their mix. */
#ifndef HORN_H
#define HORN_H
#include <stdint.h>

#define HORN_VOICES 8                /* the player's horn and 7 others' */
/* the kinds of horn, by number on the wire (roam_game.c's car look,
 * racehorn.c's message, which has room for 16): 0 dual, 1 single, 2 truck,
 * 3 train, 4 klaxon, 5 cucaracha, 6 clown, 7 trombone, 8 dixie, 9 oldcar,
 * 10 broken, 11 sputter, 12 thecar, 13 thecar_long.  A number past them (a
 * newer build's) sounds as the dual horn. */

/* 1 while the horn key (N) is held, or the controller's left stick click
 * when stick is 1: the callers pass 0 while the player's car has hydraulics,
 * whose Hydraulic Pressurize is on that click.  Game thread. */

 * names none).  And a kind's name. */
int  horn_mine(void);

/* A frame of horns, on the game thread: horn_begin with the listener (the
 * camera's position and forward, and the player's car's velocity, m and
 * m/s; pos 0: nobody else's horn can sound), horn_sound for every horn that
 * sounds now, then horn_end: a horn not sounded since horn_begin fades out.
 * who names the horn's source (one voice each), name picks its pitch (one
 * of five: a player sounds the same on every screen), kind its sound.  p
 * and v: where the car is and how it moves; p 0: the player's own horn.
 * horn_sound returns 1 when that horn starts now, 0 while it goes on, -1
 * when it is out of hearing or out of voices. */
void horn_begin(const float *pos, const float *fwd, const float *vel);
int  horn_sound(uint32_t who, const char *name, int kind, const float *p, const float *v);
void horn_end(void);
/* The player's own horn for a moment (a quarter of a second, or until the
 * next horn_end): how loud the volume makes it.  Game thread. */
void horn_preview(void);
/* How loud every horn is, HORN_VOL_MIN .. 1 (1: as made, the default);
 * a value out of that range is taken as its nearer end.  Any thread. */
#define HORN_VOL_MIN 0.1f
void horn_set_volume(float v);

 * game's own sounds are of their sliders.  horn.c asks on the game thread,
 * at horn_begin and horn_preview. */
float horn_game_master(void);
/* Adds the sounding voices to an interleaved stereo float mix.  Mixer
 * thread. */
void horn_mix(float *acc, unsigned frames, unsigned rate);

/* hornmenu.c -- the horns' volume (horn.c) on the game's own Audio options:
 * a Horn Volume slider after Engine Volume, in the menus' Options > Audio
 * (0x4B6E60, before its Audio Mode) and in the pause menu's (0x4C3370, where
 * Engine Volume is the last), from 10 % to 100 % in steps of 5 %.  Moving it
 * sounds the player's own horn for a moment at the new volume.  The value is
 * the registry's HornVolume (percent; registry.txt, the game's options),
 * read at startup; none: 100 %.  The slider itself: optslider.c (the menus'
 * UI_Options.fng has the parts for an eighth slider, the pause menu's
 * UI_PauseOptions.fng all but the bar's, which are copies of the seventh's).
 * The horns also follow the game's Master Volume (horn_game_master), as its
 * own sounds do: the sound manager ([0x82B884] +0x38: the Audio options'
 * volumes, G_VOLUMES) plays each kind at its slider times Master (0x45C210,
 * 0x471970: linear, of 0x7FFF). */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "game.h"
#include "horn.h"
#include "optslider.h"
#include "widescreen.h"           /* HOOK_SITE */
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

int  win32_reg_get_dword(const char *nm, uint32_t *out);
void win32_reg_put_dword(const char *nm, uint32_t v);
const char *language_name(void);

#define REG_NAME      "HornVolume"
#define FN_ADD        0x0054f410u   /* thiscall screen (entry, 1): the Options list takes a slider */
#define FN_ADD_PAUSE  0x0054f800u   /* thiscall screen (entry, 1): the pause menu's */

static int g_installed;
static uint32_t g_pct = 100;                     /* the volume, percent, as the registry has it */

/* the label in the game's language: the Latin-script texts as the language
 * files write their own sliders' ("Volume moteur", "Motorvolume", ...; in
 * Latin-1, as they are; Polish's "Glosnosc silnika" with the letters its
 * pack's fonts draw as Polish ones: l-stroke 0xEE, s-acute 0xE2, c-acute
 * 0xE9; Turkish's "Korna Sesi" after its "Motor Sesi", ASCII; Hungarian's
 * "Duda hangereje" after its "Motor hangereje"; Czech's "Hlasitost klaksonu"
 * after its "Hlasitost motoru"; Slovak's "Hlasitos\x9d klaks\xf3nu" after its
 * "Hlasitos\x9d motora", in Windows-1250 as its pack's fonts draw it); English for the others,
 * whose fonts have their own encodings but draw ASCII as it is (car names) */
static const char *label(void){
    static const struct { const char *lang, *text; } T[] = {
        { "french", "Volume klaxon" }, { "german", "Hupenlautst\xe4rke" }, { "italian", "Volume clacson" },
        { "spanish", "Volumen claxon" }, { "dutch", "Claxonvolume" }, { "swedish", "Tutvolym" },
        { "danish", "Lydstyrke for horn" }, { "portuguese", "Volume da Buzina" },
        { "polish", "G\xeeo\xe2no\xe2\xe9 klaksonu" }, { "turkish", "Korna Sesi" }, { "hungarian", "Duda hangereje" },
        { "czech", "Hlasitost klaksonu" }, { "slovak", "Hlasitos\x9d klaks\xf3nu" },
    };
    const char *l = language_name();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof T / sizeof T[0]; i++) if (!strcmp(l, T[i].lang)) return T[i].text;
    return "Horn Volume";
}
static float value(void){ return (float)g_pct / 100.f; }
/* the volume to the horns, the registry and a honk */
static void moved(float v){
    uint32_t pct = (uint32_t)lrintf(v * 100.f);
    if (pct < 10u) pct = 10u;
    if (pct > 100u) pct = 100u;
    horn_set_volume((float)pct / 100.f);
    if (pct != g_pct){ g_pct = pct; win32_reg_put_dword(REG_NAME, pct); fprintf(stderr, "[horn] volume %u %%\n", pct); }
    horn_preview();
}
static OptSlider g_slider = { "Horn Volume", HORN_VOL_MIN, 1.f, 0.05f, value, moved, label, 0 };

/* the registry's volume to the horns (once) */
void hornmenu_install(void){
    if (g_installed) return;
    g_installed = 1;
    uint32_t pct;
    if (win32_reg_get_dword(REG_NAME, &pct)){
        g_pct = pct < 10u ? 10u : pct > 100u ? 100u : pct;
        horn_set_volume((float)g_pct / 100.f);
        fprintf(stderr, "[horn] volume %u %% (registry %s)\n", g_pct, REG_NAME);
    }
}

/* the game's Master Volume (horn.h): 1 while its options are not there or
 * hold no volume */
float horn_game_master(void){
    if (!mem_is_committed(G_VOLUMES) || !mem_is_committed(G_VOLUMES + 3u)) return 1.f;
    float v = MRF32(G_VOLUMES);
    return v >= 0.f && v <= 1.f ? v : 1.f;
}

int hornmenu_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    switch (ip){
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004b7102): hornmenu_install(); optslider_add(c, c->esi, FN_ADD, &g_slider); return 1;          /* Options > Audio: after Engine Volume, before Audio Mode */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004c36a3): hornmenu_install(); optslider_add(c, c->esi, FN_ADD_PAUSE, &g_slider); return 1;    /* the pause menu's: after Engine Volume */
    }
    return 0;
}

/* hqvinyls.c -- HQ vinyls: the cars' vinyls and doorlines at 1024x1024, as
 * AdrienShadow's "High Quality Vinyls & Doorlines (1024x Upscaled)"
 * (https://nfsmods.xyz/mod/8064) has them.  hq_vinyls = on
 * (NFSU2_HQ_VINYLS=1); off here, on from the page on computers.  Browser only:
 * the page does the painting (web/src/gpu/hqskin.ts), on a PC (GW_FEAT_HQSKIN).
 *
 * The game paints a car's skin on the CPU: base paint, its vinyl layers 0-3 and
 * the doorline, each picture through its _MASK, into a 512x512 texture
 * (DUMMY_SKIN<n>; free roam's own for its other cars), one target pixel per
 * layer pixel (0x611F10).  The mod makes every picture and the targets 1024 in
 * the game's files.  Here the game's files and its 512 skin stay as they are:
 * once the game has painted a skin, the recipe it painted from goes to the
 * page, which paints it again at 1024 from the mod's pictures
 * (HQVINYLS/CARS/<car>.hqv, tools/hqvinyls.py) with the same arithmetic and
 * shows that in the skin's place, until the game paints that texture again.
 * A car with a picture the pack lacks (Art Factory 28-34) keeps the game's.
 *
 * The recipe (0x611F10's argument, on 0x61D790's stack; its one caller is
 * 0x61DDF0): +0 the target's TextureInfo, +4 the base paint, +8 seven swatch
 * colours (the page takes those from the game's 512 skin), +0x24 up to 8
 * layers of 0x34 bytes, +0x1C4 their count.  A layer: +0 its picture's name
 * hash, +4 its TextureInfo, +8 its mask's, +0xC / +0x14 their pixels (A8R8G8B8,
 * locked for the call), +0x20 REMAP (coloured by +0x24's colours 0-2 by the
 * picture's R, G, B), +0x24 four colours.  Colours are R, G, B, A bytes until
 * 0x611F10 swaps them in place: read before it runs.  A layer without REMAP
 * is drawn as it is, alpha too (the skin's alpha is its gloss); the mod's
 * pictures have none (all 255), so the game's own alpha goes with the recipe.
 * DUMMY_SKIN1-6 keep the last recipe (0x89F050): the same one again is not
 * painted, nor sent. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include "game.h"
#include "setting.h"
#include "web/gpu_proto.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define RET_PAINT       0x0061ddf5u   /* 0x61DDF0's call of 0x611F10 returns here */
#define RCP_TARGET      0x000u        /* the recipe: the target's TextureInfo */
#define RCP_BASE        0x004u        /* ... the base paint */
#define RCP_LAYERS      0x024u        /* ... the layers */
#define RCP_COUNT       0x1c4u        /* ... their count */
#define RCP_RIDE        0x36cu        /* (0x61DDF0's frame) the ride, 0x61D790's argument: +0 its car type */
#define LAYER_SIZE      0x34u
#define L_HASH          0x00u
#define L_MASK_TI       0x08u
#define L_PIXELS        0x0cu
#define L_MASK_PIXELS   0x14u
#define L_REMAP         0x20u
#define L_COLOURS       0x24u
#define SIDE            GW_SKIN_HQ_SIDE
#define LOG_MAX         40            /* paints logged one by one */

/* gpu_web.c in the browser; the Mac paints nothing again */
__attribute__((weak)) int gw_hqskin_ok(void){ return 0; }
__attribute__((weak)) void gw_skin_hq(unsigned id, const GwSkinHq *r, const uint8_t *const *planes, unsigned nplanes){
    (void)id; (void)r; (void)planes; (void)nplanes;
}

static int g_on = -1;
static uint32_t g_serial;
static unsigned g_logged, g_sent, g_planes;

static int hq_on(void){
    if (g_on < 0){
        g_on = setting_bool("NFSU2_HQ_VINYLS", 0);
        if (g_on) fprintf(stderr, "[hqvinyls] on: the page paints the cars' skins again at 1024 (%s)\n",
                          gw_hqskin_ok() ? "it can" : "not this page: a phone, no BC, or not the browser");
    }
    return g_on && gw_hqskin_ok();
}

/* the car's texture name ("350Z"): its CarTypeInfo +0x20 */
static int car_name(uint32_t ride, char out[16]){
    uint32_t types = guest_rd32(G_CARTYPES), type = guest_rd32(ride);
    if (!types || type > 0x400u) return 0;
    uint32_t a = types + type * CARTYPE_SIZE + CARTYPE_TEXNAME;
    if (!guest_ok_bytes(a, 16)) return 0;
    memset(out, 0, 16);
    for (int k = 0; k < 15; k++){
        char ch = (char)MR8(a + (uint32_t)k);
        if (!ch) break;
        if (!((ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9'))) return 0;
        out[k] = ch;
    }
    return out[0] != 0;
}

/* a layer drawn as it is: its alpha where its mask draws it, one value or the game's 512 plane (malloc'd) */
static uint32_t layer_alpha(uint32_t px, uint32_t mpx, uint8_t **plane){
    const uint32_t n = SIDE * SIDE;
    int one = -1, many = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && !many; i++){
        if (!MR8(mpx + 4u * i + 1u)) continue;            /* the mask's G: 0 = not drawn here */
        int a = MR8(px + 4u * i + 3u);
        if (one < 0) one = a; else if (a != one) many = 1;
    }
    if (!many) return one < 0 ? 255u : (uint32_t)one;
    uint8_t *p = malloc(n);
    if (!p) return 255u;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = MR8(px + 4u * i + 3u);
    *plane = p;
    return GW_SKIN_HQ_PLANE;
}

/* the recipe as the page wants it, before 0x611F10 swaps its colours; 0: not one to paint again */
static int recipe(uint32_t r, GwSkinHq *q, uint8_t **planes, unsigned *np){
    uint32_t ti = guest_rd32(r + RCP_TARGET), n = guest_rd32(r + RCP_COUNT);
    if (!ti || !guest_ok(ti, 0x7c) || MR16(ti + TI_WIDTH) != SIDE || MR16(ti + TI_HEIGHT) != SIDE) return 0;
    if (!n || n > GW_SKIN_HQ_LAYERS) return 0;                 /* no layer: nothing to paint sharper */
    memset(q, 0, sizeof *q);
    q->magic = GW_SKIN_HQ_MAGIC;
    if (!car_name(guest_rd32(r + RCP_RIDE), q->car)) return 0;
    q->base = MR32(r + RCP_BASE);
    q->n = n;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++){
        uint32_t L = r + RCP_LAYERS + i * LAYER_SIZE;
        GwSkinHqLayer *l = &q->layer[i];
        uint32_t mti = guest_rd32(L + L_MASK_TI), px = guest_rd32(L + L_PIXELS), mpx = guest_rd32(L + L_MASK_PIXELS);
        l->hash = MR32(L + L_HASH);
        l->mask = mti && guest_ok(mti + TI_HASH, 3) ? MR32(mti + TI_HASH) : 0;
        if (!l->hash || !l->mask) return 0;
        l->remap = MR32(L + L_REMAP) != 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) l->col[k] = MR32(L + L_COLOURS + 4u * (uint32_t)k);
        if (l->remap) continue;
        if (!guest_ok_bytes(px, SIDE * SIDE * 4u) || !guest_ok_bytes(mpx, SIDE * SIDE * 4u)) return 0;
        l->alpha = layer_alpha(px, mpx, &planes[*np]);
        if (l->alpha == GW_SKIN_HQ_PLANE) (*np)++;
    }
    q->serial = ++g_serial;
    return 1;
}

void sub_00611f10_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_00611f10(CPU *c){
    uint32_t r = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    GwSkinHq q;
    uint8_t *planes[GW_SKIN_HQ_LAYERS] = { 0 };
    unsigned np = 0;
    int want = hq_on() && MR32(c->esp) == RET_PAINT && recipe(r, &q, planes, &np);
    sub_00611f10_orig(c);                                      /* the game's 512 skin, as always */
    if (want && c->eax){
        uint32_t ti = guest_rd32(r + RCP_TARGET), pl = guest_rd32(ti + TI_PLAT);
        uint32_t tex = pl ? guest_rd32(pl + PLAT_D3DTEX) : 0, id = tex ? guest_rd32(tex + D3DTEX_ID) : 0;
        if (id){
            gw_skin_hq(id, &q, (const uint8_t *const *)planes, np);
            g_sent++; g_planes += np;
            if (g_logged < LOG_MAX){
                g_logged++;
                fprintf(stderr, "[hqvinyls] skin t%u (0x%08x): %s, %u layer(s), %u alpha plane(s)%s\n", id,
                        MR32(ti + TI_HASH), q.car, q.n, np, g_logged == LOG_MAX ? "; no more of these lines" : "");
            }
        }
    }
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < np; k++) free(planes[k]);
}
